exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, use the prompts and the adjectives in the list to ask and answer questions, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda ko'rsatmalar va ro'yxatdagi sifatlardan foydalanib namunalardagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI KO'RSATMA:
  • visit Prague? - last summer
  • ride a camel? - no
  • stay in a big hotel? - last winter
  • eat Chinese food? - last Sunday
  • meet a famous person? - no
  • drive a bus? - no
  • fly in a plane? - a month ago

SIFATLAR:
  exciting, fantastic, amazing, delicious,
  great, awful, horrible, terrible, disgusting


KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA:

  SA: Have you EVER VISITED Prague?
  SB: Yes, I HAVE.
  SA: WHEN DID you VISIT Prague?
  SB: Last summer. It was exciting.

  SA: Have you EVER RIDDEN a camel?
  SB: No, I HAVEN'T. I've NEVER RIDDEN a camel.


IKKI QOLIP:

  A) JAVOB 'HA' bo'lsa (vaqt berilgan):
     SA: Have you ever [V3] ...?
     SB: Yes, I have.
     SA: When did you [V1] ...?
     SB: [vaqt]. It was [sifat].

  B) JAVOB 'YO'Q' bo'lsa:
     SA: Have you ever [V3] ...?
     SB: No, I haven't. I've never [V3] ...


BARCHA YETTI DIALOG:

 1  SA: Have you ever VISITED Prague?
    SB: Yes, I have.
    SA: When did you VISIT Prague?
    SB: Last summer. It was EXCITING.
        (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  SA: Have you ever RIDDEN a camel?
    SB: No, I haven't. I've never RIDDEN a
        camel.
        (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 3  SA: Have you ever STAYED in a big hotel?
    SB: Yes, I have.
    SA: When did you STAY in a big hotel?
    SB: Last winter. It was FANTASTIC.

 4  SA: Have you ever EATEN Chinese food?
    SB: Yes, I have.
    SA: When did you EAT Chinese food?
    SB: Last Sunday. It was DELICIOUS.

 5  SA: Have you ever MET a famous person?
    SB: No, I haven't. I've never MET a famous
        person.

 6  SA: Have you ever DRIVEN a bus?
    SB: No, I haven't. I've never DRIVEN a bus.

 7  SA: Have you ever FLOWN in a plane?
    SB: Yes, I have.
    SA: When did you FLY in a plane?
    SB: A month ago. It was AMAZING.


⚠ ENG MUHIM QISM — III ShAKL (V3):

  Savolda V3, javobda V1 ishlatiladi!

  SAVOL (Present Perfect)   JAVOB (Past Simple)
  ─────────────────────     ──────────────────
  Have you ever VISITED?    When did you VISIT?
  Have you ever RIDDEN?     (—)
  Have you ever STAYED?     When did you STAY?
  Have you ever EATEN?      When did you EAT?
  Have you ever MET?        (—)
  Have you ever DRIVEN?     (—)
  Have you ever FLOWN?      When did you FLY?

  DIQQAT: 'did' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY
  shaklda!
     'When did you EAT?'    ✓
     'When did you ATE?'    ✗
     'When did you EATEN?'  ✗


UCh ASOSIY ShAKL (mashqdagi fe'llar):

  visit  →  visited  →  VISITED   (to'g'ri)
  ride   →  rode     →  RIDDEN
  stay   →  stayed   →  STAYED    (to'g'ri)
  eat    →  ate      →  EATEN
  meet   →  met      →  MET
  drive  →  drove    →  DRIVEN
  fly    →  flew     →  FLOWN

  DIQQAT: 'ridden', 'eaten', 'driven',
  'flown' — bularni YODLASh kerak.


SIFATLAR IKKI GURUHDA:

  IJOBIY:
     exciting  (hayajonli)
     fantastic (ajoyib)
     amazing   (hayratlanarli)
     delicious (juda mazali — faqat OVQAT)
     great     (zo'r)

  SALBIY:
     awful      (juda yomon)
     horrible   (dahshatli)
     terrible   (dahshatli)
     disgusting (jirkanch — ko'pincha OVQAT)

  DIQQAT: 'delicious' va 'disgusting'
  asosan OVQAT haqida ishlatiladi, shuning
  uchun 4-bandga (Chinese food) mos keladi.


DIQQAT — 'FLY IN A PLANE':
  'to fly IN a plane' = samolyotda uchmoq
  ('to fly ON a plane' ham uchraydi,
   lekin 'in' standart)


DIQQAT — 'A MONTH AGO':
  'a month AGO' — PAST SIMPLE ko'rsatkichi.
  Shuning uchun javob: 'A month ago.'
  va 'It WAS amazing.'

  DIQQAT: 'ago' bilan Present Perfect
  ISHLATILMAYDI!


RASM:
  Otliq bronza haykal — Pragadagi mashhur
  Avliyo Vatslav haykali (Wenceslas Square).
  1-bandga ('visit Prague') ishora.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Prague       = Praga (Chexiya poytaxti)
  a famous person = mashhur odam
  to fly       = uchmoq (fly → flew → FLOWN)
  exciting     = hayajonli
  awful        = juda yomon
  terrible     = dahshatli

tasks.en: In pairs, use the prompts and the adjectives in the list to ask and answer questions, as in the examples.
tasks.uz: Juftlikda ko'rsatmalar va ro'yxatdagi sifatlardan foydalanib namunalardagidek savol-javob qiling.

tasks.en: SA: Have you ever visited Prague?  SB: Yes, I have.  SA: When did you visit Prague?  SB: Last summer. It was exciting.
tasks.uz: SA: Pragaga borganmisiz? SB: Ha. SA: Qachon borgansiz? SB: O'tgan yozda. Hayajonli edi.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 1-NAMUNA.
⚠ Savolda V3 ('visited'), 'did' dan keyin
V1 ('visit').

tasks.en: SA: Have you ever ridden a camel?  SB: No, I haven't. I've never ridden a camel.
tasks.uz: SA: Tuyaga minganmisiz? SB: Yo'q. Hech qachon tuyaga minmaganman.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 2-NAMUNA.
ride → rode → RIDDEN (V3).
Javob 'yo'q' bo'lsa vaqt so'ralmaydi.

tasks.en: SA: Have you ever stayed in a big hotel?  SB: Yes, I have.  SA: When did you stay in a big hotel?  SB: Last winter. It was fantastic.
tasks.uz: SA: Katta mehmonxonada turganmisiz? SB: Ha. SA: Qachon? SB: O'tgan qishda. Ajoyib edi.
tasks.note:
stay — TO'G'RI fe'l: stayed → STAYED.
'stay IN a hotel' — predlog 'in'.

tasks.en: SA: Have you ever eaten Chinese food?  SB: Yes, I have.  SA: When did you eat Chinese food?  SB: Last Sunday. It was delicious.
tasks.uz: SA: Xitoy taomini yeb ko'rganmisiz? SB: Ha. SA: Qachon? SB: O'tgan yakshanba. Juda mazali edi.
tasks.note:
eat → ate → EATEN (V3).
'DELICIOUS' — ovqat uchun eng mos sifat.
DIQQAT: 'When did you EAT?' ('ate' EMAS).

tasks.en: SA: Have you ever met a famous person?  SB: No, I haven't. I've never met a famous person.
tasks.uz: SA: Mashhur odam bilan uchrashganmisiz? SB: Yo'q. Hech qachon uchrashmaganman.
tasks.note: meet → met → MET (V2 = V3).

tasks.en: SA: Have you ever driven a bus?  SB: No, I haven't. I've never driven a bus.
tasks.uz: SA: Avtobus haydaganmisiz? SB: Yo'q. Hech qachon haydamaganman.
tasks.note:
drive → drove → DRIVEN (V3).
'ridden', 'driven' — '-en' bilan tugaydi.

tasks.en: SA: Have you ever flown in a plane?  SB: Yes, I have.  SA: When did you fly in a plane?  SB: A month ago. It was amazing.
tasks.uz: SA: Samolyotda uchganmisiz? SB: Ha. SA: Qachon? SB: Bir oy oldin. Hayratlanarli edi.
tasks.note:
fly → flew → FLOWN (V3).
'a month AGO' — PAST SIMPLE ko'rsatkichi.
DIQQAT: 'ago' bilan Present Perfect
ISHLATILMAYDI!

exercises.instructionEn: Present Perfect + Yet/Already
exercises.instructionUz: Present Perfect + Yet/Already
exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use ALREADY in POSITIVE STATEMENTS.'
 • 'We use YET in QUESTIONS and NEGATIVES.'

 MISOLLAR:
    Have you packed your suitcase YET?
    No, I haven't. I haven't packed it YET.
    Yes, I have. I've ALREADY packed it.


QISQA JADVAL:

  ALREADY  →  TASDIQ gapda
              'I've ALREADY packed it.'

  YET      →  SAVOLDA
              'Have you packed it YET?'
           →  INKORDA
              'I haven't packed it YET.'


QAYERDA TURADI:

  ALREADY — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA:
     'I've ALREADY packed it.'
     'She has ALREADY left.'

     (Ba'zan gap oxirida ham keladi, lekin
      o'rtada turgani standart.)

  YET — GAP OXIRIDA:
     'Have you packed it YET?'
     'I haven't packed it YET.'

     'Have you YET packed it?' — XATO.


MA'NOLARI:

  ALREADY = allaqachon
     Kutilganidan ERTAROQ bo'lgan ish.
     'I've already packed.' = kutmagan
     edingiz, lekin men allaqachon
     yig'ib bo'ldim.

  YET = hali
     Kutilayotgan, lekin HALI bo'lmagan ish.
     'I haven't packed yet.' = hali
     yig'madim (lekin yig'ishim kerak).

  Ya'ni 'yet' KUTILAYOTGAN ishni bildiradi.


DIQQAT — 'YET' va 'STILL':
  'I haven't packed YET.'
     = hali yig'madim (neytral)
  'I STILL haven't packed.'
     = hali ham yig'madim (sabrsizlik,
       ajablanish)

  'still' — 'haven't' dan OLDIN.


DIQQAT — 'ALREADY' SAVOLDA:
  Ba'zan savolda ham ishlatiladi, lekin
  AJABLANISH ma'nosida:
     'Have you ALREADY packed?'
     = Allaqachon yig'ib bo'ldingizmi?
       (Shunchalik tezmi?)

  Oddiy savolda esa 'yet':
     'Have you packed YET?'


BOG'LIQLIK — 105-BETDAGI XAT:
  'I've ALREADY visited the bazaar.'
     (tasdiq)
  'I haven't been on a boat trip YET.'
     (inkor)
  'There are a lot of things I haven't
   done YET.'
     (inkor)

  Jekning xati bu qoidani aynan ishlatgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  already     = allaqachon
  yet         = hali
  to pack     = (yukni) yig'moq
  a suitcase  = chamadon
  a positive statement = tasdiq gap

tasks.en: Present Perfect + Yet/Already
tasks.uz: Present Perfect + Yet/Already

tasks.en: We use already in positive statements.
tasks.uz: ALREADY ni tasdiq gaplarda ishlatamiz.
tasks.note: 'already' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.

tasks.en: We use yet in questions and negatives.
tasks.uz: YET ni savol va inkor gaplarda ishlatamiz.
tasks.note: 'yet' — GAP OXIRIDA.

tasks.en: Have you packed your suitcase yet?
tasks.uz: Chamadoningizni yig'ib bo'ldingizmi?
tasks.note:
SAVOL + YET (gap oxirida).
'Have you yet packed it?' — XATO.

tasks.en: No, I haven't. I haven't packed it yet.
tasks.uz: Yo'q. Hali yig'madim.
tasks.note:
INKOR + YET (gap oxirida).
'yet' = hali (kutilayotgan ish).

tasks.en: Yes, I have. I've already packed it.
tasks.uz: Ha. Allaqachon yig'ib bo'ldim.
tasks.note:
TASDIQ + ALREADY ('have' va V3 orasida).
'already' = kutilganidan ertaroq.

exercises.instructionEn: Tony and Ann are in Paris on holiday. Look at the table, then listen and tick the activities that they have already done and put a cross next to those that they haven't done yet. — the two rows the book itself gives
exercises.instructionUz: Toni va Enn Parijda ta'tilda. Jadvalga qarang, so'ngra tinglang va allaqachon qilgan ishlariga ✓, hali qilmagan ishlariga ✗ qo'ying. — kitobning O'ZI bergan ikki qator
exercises.explanationUz:
VAZIYAT: Toni va Enn Parijda ta'tilda.

JADVALDA YETTI ISh:
  visit the Eiffel Tower
  go to Versailles
  go shopping at the Galleries Lafayette
  see the Arc de Triomphe
  go on a boat trip on the Seine
  visit the Louvre
  see Notre Dame


KITOB IKKI QATORNI TO'LDIRIB BERGAN:
  visit the Eiffel Tower  →  ✓ (qilishgan)
  go to Versailles        →  ✗ (qilishmagan)

  Qolgan BESh qator faqat AUDIODAN
  aniqlanadi (quyidagi alohida ro'yxatga
  qarang).


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA DIALOG:

  SA: Have they visited the Eiffel Tower YET?
  SB: Yes, they have ALREADY visited the
      Eiffel Tower. Have they been to
      Versailles YET?
  SA: No, they HAVEN'T been to Versailles YET.


IKKI QOLIP:

  ✓ bo'lsa:
     'Have they [V3] ... YET?'
     'Yes, they have ALREADY [V3] ...'

  ✗ bo'lsa:
     'Have they [V3] ... YET?'
     'No, they HAVEN'T [V3] ... YET.'


⚠ 'YET' va 'ALREADY' NING O'RNI —
NAMUNADA ANIQ KO'RINADI:

  SAVOLDA:  'yet' — GAP OXIRIDA
     'Have they visited the Eiffel Tower YET?'

  TASDIQ JAVOBDA:  'already' — 'have' va V3
     ORASIDA
     'they have ALREADY visited ...'

  INKOR JAVOBDA:  'yet' — GAP OXIRIDA
     'they haven't been to Versailles YET.'


PARIJDAGI YETTI JOY — NIMA EKANI:

  the Eiffel Tower — Eyfel minorasi (1889)
  Versailles — Versal saroyi (Parij tashqarisida)
  the Galleries Lafayette — mashhur universmag
  the Arc de Triomphe — Zafar arki
  the Seine — Sena daryosi
  the Louvre — Luvr muzeyi (Mona Liza shu yerda)
  Notre Dame — Notr-Dam sobori


DIQQAT — FE'LLARNING V3 ShAKLI:
  visit  →  VISITED   (to'g'ri fe'l)
  go     →  BEEN / GONE
  see    →  SEEN

  DIQQAT: 'go to Versailles' savolda
  'have they BEEN to Versailles' bo'ladi —
  chunki ular u yerdan QAYTGAN bo'lardi.
  ('have they GONE' = hali u yerda degani.)

  Kitobdagi namuna aynan shunday:
  'Have they BEEN to Versailles yet?'


RASM:
  Eyfel minorasi va oldidagi favvoralar
  (Trocadéro bog'idan ko'rinish).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an activity   = mashg'ulot, ish
  to tick       = ✓ qo'ymoq
  a cross       = ✗ belgisi
  the Eiffel Tower = Eyfel minorasi
  a tower       = minora
  to go shopping = xarid qilgani bormoq
  an arch       = ark, tok
  a boat trip   = qayiqda sayohat

tasks.prompt: visit the Eiffel Tower
tasks.whyUz:
KITOBDA ✓ ALLAQACHON QO'YILGAN (namuna).

Namuna dialogda ham tasdiqlanadi:
'Yes, they have ALREADY visited the Eiffel
Tower.'

TO'LIQ GAP:
They have already visited the Eiffel Tower.

tasks.prompt: go to Versailles
tasks.whyUz:
KITOBDA ✗ ALLAQACHON QO'YILGAN (namuna).

Namuna dialogda ham tasdiqlanadi:
'No, they HAVEN'T been to Versailles YET.'

DIQQAT: savolda 'go' emas, 'BEEN' ishlatiladi
('have they GONE' = hali u yerda degani).

TO'LIQ GAP:
They haven't been to Versailles yet.

exercises.instructionEn: Ex. 13 — the five rows that can only be completed from the recording
exercises.instructionUz: 13-mashq — faqat audiodan aniqlanadigan besh qator
exercises.explanationUz:
OChIQ QOLGAN 5 QATOR

Quyidagi beshta ish betning HECH YERIDA
belgilanmagan. Ularni faqat Toni va Ennning
suhbatini tinglab aniqlash mumkin.

TAXMIN BILAN TO'LDIRILMADI.


  1  go shopping at the Galleries Lafayette
     (Galeri Lafayet universmagida xarid
      qilish)
     ✓  yoki  ✗   →  ........

  2  see the Arc de Triomphe
     (Zafar arkini ko'rish)
     ✓  yoki  ✗   →  ........

  3  go on a boat trip on the Seine
     (Sena daryosida qayiqda sayohat)
     ✓  yoki  ✗   →  ........

  4  visit the Louvre
     (Luvr muzeyiga borish)
     ✓  yoki  ✗   →  ........

  5  see Notre Dame
     (Notr-Dam soborini ko'rish)

exercises.instructionEn: Present Perfect + Just
exercises.instructionUz: Present Perfect + Just
exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use JUST in statements to show that an
    action finished only A FEW MINUTES EARLIER.'

 MISOL:
    A: Have you packed your suitcase yet?
    B: Yes, I've JUST packed it.


'JUST' NING MA'NOSI:
  'just' = hozirgina, endigina

  Harakat BIR NECHA DAQIQA oldin tugagan.

     'I've JUST arrived.'    = hozirgina keldim
     'She's JUST left.'      = u endigina ketdi
     'We've JUST finished.'  = endigina
                               tugatdik


QAYERDA TURADI:
  'have' va V3 ORASIDA:
     'I've JUST packed it.'  ✓
     'I've packed it JUST.'  ✗
     'JUST I've packed it.'  ✗

  Xuddi 'already' kabi.


UCh RAVIShNI SOLIShTIRING:

  JUST     — hozirgina (bir necha daqiqa
             oldin)
             'I've just packed it.'

  ALREADY  — allaqachon (kutilganidan
             ertaroq)
             'I've already packed it.'

  YET      — hali (kutilayotgan, lekin hali
             bo'lmagan)
             'I haven't packed it yet.'

  Hammasi Present Perfect bilan.
  JUST va ALREADY — TASDIQDA, o'rtada.
  YET — SAVOL/INKORDA, gap oxirida.


DIQQAT — 'JUST' NING BOShQA MA'NOLARI:
  'just' — faqat (only)
     'I have JUST one question.'
  'just' — aynan
     'That's JUST what I wanted.'
  'just' — shunchaki
     'The food was JUST delicious.'
     (105-betdagi Jekning xatidan!)

  Present Perfect bilan esa 'hozirgina'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  just    = hozirgina, endigina
  earlier = oldinroq
  to pack = (yukni) yig'moq

exercises.explanationUz:
BESh KO'RSATMA:
  1  book a table
  2  pack our swimming costumes
  3  find the tickets
  4  talk to the receptionist
  5  meet Steve


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: Have you BOOKED a table YET?
  SB: Yes, I've JUST BOOKED it.


QOLIP:
  SA: Have you [V3] ... YET?
  SB: Yes, I've JUST [V3] it/them/him.


BARCHA BESh DIALOG:

 1  SA: Have you BOOKED a table YET?
    SB: Yes, I've JUST BOOKED it.
        (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  SA: Have you PACKED our swimming costumes
        YET?
    SB: Yes, I've JUST PACKED THEM.

 3  SA: Have you FOUND the tickets YET?
    SB: Yes, I've JUST FOUND THEM.

 4  SA: Have you TALKED to the receptionist
        YET?
    SB: Yes, I've JUST TALKED to HIM.
        (yoki 'to HER')

 5  SA: Have you MET Steve YET?
    SB: Yes, I've JUST MET HIM.


⚠ ENG NOZIK QISM — OLMOSh TO'G'RI TANLANIShI:

  BIRLIK narsa    →  IT
     'a table'         → it

  KO'PLIK narsa   →  THEM
     'swimming costumes' → them
     'the tickets'       → them

  ERKAK odam      →  HIM
     'the receptionist' → him (yoki her)
     'Steve'            → him

  Bu — mashqning eng ko'p xato qilinadigan
  joyi!


V3 ShAKLLARI:
  book  →  booked  →  BOOKED   (to'g'ri)
  pack  →  packed  →  PACKED   (to'g'ri)
  find  →  found   →  FOUND    (V2 = V3)
  talk  →  talked  →  TALKED   (to'g'ri)
  meet  →  met     →  MET      (V2 = V3)


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI PREDLOG:
  'talk TO the receptionist'
  'to talk TO somebody' — predlog 'to'.

  Javobda ham saqlanadi:
     'I've just talked TO him.'


DIQQAT — 5-BANDDA PREDLOG YO'Q:
  'MEET Steve' — predlogsiz.
     'meet somebody'  ✓
     'meet WITH somebody' — amerikacha,
        rasmiy uchrashuv uchun

  Javobda: 'I've just met HIM.'


VAZIYAT — BU DIALOGLAR NIMA HAQIDA:
  Beshala ko'rsatma TA'TILGA TAYYORGARLIK
  haqida:
     stol band qilish (restoranda)
     cho'milish kiyimlarini yig'ish
     chiptalarni topish
     administrator bilan gaplashish
     Stiv bilan uchrashish

  Ya'ni ikki kishi jo'nashdan oldin
  ro'yxatni tekshirmoqda.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to book a table   = stol band qilmoq
  a swimming costume = cho'milish kiyimi
  to find           = topmoq (find → FOUND)
  a ticket          = chipta
  a receptionist    = administrator
  to meet           = uchrashmoq (meet → MET)

exercises.instructionEn: Present Perfect + For/Since
exercises.instructionUz: Present Perfect + For/Since
exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use FOR to express DURATION.'
      I've been here FOR five days.

 • 'We use SINCE to state a STARTING POINT.'
      I've been here SINCE Monday.


ENG ODDIY FARQ:

  FOR    +  QANChA VAQT (davomiylik)
            for five days
            for two years
            for a long time
            for ten minutes

  SINCE  +  QAChONDAN BERI (boshlanish nuqtasi)
            since Monday
            since 1987
            since last week
            since I was a child


QANDAY ESLAB QOLISh:

  Savol bering: 'QANChA VAQT?' yoki
  'QAChONDAN BERI?'

     'five days'  → qancha vaqt?  → FOR
     'Monday'     → qachondan?    → SINCE
     'two years'  → qancha vaqt?  → FOR
     '1987'       → qachondan?    → SINCE

  Ya'ni:
     RAQAM + vaqt birligi  →  FOR
     ANIQ NUQTA (kun, sana, yil)  →  SINCE


MISOLLAR YONMA-YON:

  FOR                    SINCE
  ─────────────────      ──────────────────
  for three days         since Monday
  for two years          since 2010
  for a week             since last week
  for ten minutes        since 5 o'clock
  for a long time        since I came here
  for ages               since my birthday

  DIQQAT — 'a week' va 'last week':
     FOR a week    = bir hafta davomida
     SINCE last week = o'tgan haftadan beri


DIQQAT — 'SINCE' + TO'LIQ GAP:
  'since' dan keyin GAP ham kelishi mumkin:
     'I've been here SINCE I ARRIVED.'
     'I haven't seen him SINCE HE LEFT.'

  Bunda gap PAST SIMPLE da bo'ladi.


IKKALASI HAM PRESENT PERFECT BILAN:
  'I've been here for five days.'  ✓
  'I am here for five days.'  — boshqa ma'no
                                (reja)
  'I was here for five days.' — o'tmish
                                (tugagan)

  Present Perfect — harakat HALI DAVOM
  etayotganini ko'rsatadi.


DIQQAT — 'FOR' TUShIRIB QOLDIRILIShI MUMKIN:
  'I've been here (for) five days.'
  Og'zaki nutqda 'for' ba'zan tushiriladi.
  'since' esa HECH QAChON tushirilmaydi.


DIQQAT — 'AGO' BILAN ADAShTIRMANG:
  'five days AGO'  →  PAST SIMPLE
     'I arrived five days ago.'
  'FOR five days'  →  PRESENT PERFECT
     'I've been here for five days.'

  Ikkalasi ham 'besh kun' haqida, lekin
  zamonlari BOSHQA.


BOG'LIQLIK — 105-BETDAGI XAT:
  'I've been here SINCE MONDAY.'
  Jekning xati aynan shu qurilmani
  ishlatgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  duration       = davomiylik
  a starting point = boshlanish nuqtasi
  for            = ... davomida
  since          = ... dan beri

exercises.instructionEn: Expand the notes into sentences using for or since.
exercises.instructionUz: Qisqa yozuvlarni for yoki since bilan to'liq gaplarga aylantiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  He/be in Cairo/Friday
    → He HAS BEEN in Cairo SINCE Friday.
       (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  He/live in Rome/three years
    → He HAS LIVED in Rome FOR three years.

 3  I/not see/Jane/ten years
    → I HAVEN'T SEEN Jane FOR ten years.

 4  I/not travel/by plane/1987
    → I HAVEN'T TRAVELLED by plane SINCE 1987.

 5  They/be/on holiday/last Monday
    → They HAVE BEEN on holiday SINCE last
      Monday.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
 1  U juma kunidan beri Qohirada.
 2  U uch yildan beri Rimda yashaydi.
 3  Jeynni o'n yildan beri ko'rmaganman.
 4  1987-yildan beri samolyotda
    sayohat qilmaganman.
 5  Ular o'tgan dushanbadan beri ta'tilda.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — OXIRGI QISMGA QARANG:

  1  'Friday'      → KUN → SINCE
  2  'three years' → QANCHA VAQT → FOR
  3  'ten years'   → QANCHA VAQT → FOR
  4  '1987'        → YIL → SINCE
  5  'last Monday' → ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE

  Ya'ni:
     FOR — 2, 3 (raqam + vaqt birligi)
     SINCE — 1, 4, 5 (kun, yil, aniq nuqta)


QISQA YOZUVNI TO'LIQ GAPGA AYLANTIRISh —
NIMA QO'ShILADI:

  1) HAVE / HAS
     ega III shaxs birlik bo'lsa → HAS
     (1, 2-bandlar: 'He')
     qolganlarida → HAVE
     (3, 4-bandlar: 'I'; 5-band: 'They')

  2) FE'LNING III ShAKLI (V3)
     be    → BEEN
     live  → LIVED
     see   → SEEN
     travel → TRAVELLED

  3) 'NOT' bo'lsa → HAVEN'T / HASN'T
     (3, 4-bandlar)

  4) FOR yoki SINCE


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  'He/be in Cairo/Friday'
    ega 'He' → HAS
    be → BEEN
    'Friday' → kun → SINCE
    → 'He HAS BEEN in Cairo SINCE Friday.'

 2  'He/live in Rome/three years'
    ega 'He' → HAS
    live → LIVED (to'g'ri fe'l)
    'three years' → davomiylik → FOR
    → 'He HAS LIVED in Rome FOR three years.'

 3  'I/not see/Jane/ten years'
    ega 'I' → HAVE, 'not' bor → HAVEN'T
    see → SEEN
    'ten years' → davomiylik → FOR
    → 'I HAVEN'T SEEN Jane FOR ten years.'

 4  'I/not travel/by plane/1987'
    ega 'I' → HAVEN'T
    travel → TRAVELLED
       (britancha: L IKKILANADI!)
    '1987' → yil → SINCE
    → 'I HAVEN'T TRAVELLED by plane SINCE
       1987.'

 5  'They/be/on holiday/last Monday'
    ega 'They' → HAVE
    be → BEEN
    'last Monday' → aniq nuqta → SINCE
    → 'They HAVE BEEN on holiday SINCE last
       Monday.'


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI 'TRAVELLED':
  BRITANCHA:  travel → TRAVELLED (LL)
  AMERIKACHA: travel → TRAVELED  (L)

  Enterprise — britancha kitob, shuning uchun
  IKKI 'L'.

  Shu kabi: cancel → cancelled,
  quarrel → quarrelled.


DIQQAT — 3 va 4-BANDLAR INKORDA:
  'I HAVEN'T seen Jane FOR ten years.'
  = o'n yildan beri ko'rmadim (va hozir ham
    ko'rmayapman)

  INKOR gapda ham 'for/since' ishlatiladi.


DIQQAT — 'BY PLANE':
  'travel BY plane / BY car / BY train / BY
   bus'
  Transport vositasi 'BY' bilan, ARTIKLSIZ.

  ISTISNO: 'ON FOOT' (piyoda) — 'by foot'
  XATO.


DIQQAT — 'ON HOLIDAY':
  'They have been ON HOLIDAY.'
  'on holiday' — turg'un ibora, artiklsiz.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to expand    = kengaytirmoq
  notes        = qisqa yozuvlar
  Rome         = Rim
  to travel    = sayohat qilmoq
  by plane     = samolyotda
  on holiday   = ta'tilda

exercises.instructionEn: Present Perfect — Regular Verb (work)
exercises.instructionUz: Present Perfect — to'g'ri fe'l (work)
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'G'RI FE'L: work → worked → WORKED
(V2 va V3 BIR XIL)


TASDIQ (Affirmative):

  TO'LIQ SHAKL          QISQA SHAKL
  I have worked         I'VE worked
  you have worked       YOU'VE worked
  he has worked         HE'S worked
  she has worked        SHE'S worked
  it has worked         IT'S worked
  we have worked        WE'VE worked
  you have worked       YOU'VE worked
  they have worked      THEY'VE worked


SO'ROQ (Interrogative):

  Have I worked?        Have we worked?
  Have you worked?      Have you worked?
  Has he worked?        Have they worked?
  Has she worked?
  Has it worked?


INKOR (Negative):

  TO'LIQ SHAKL              QISQA SHAKL
  I have not worked         I HAVEN'T worked
  you have not worked       you HAVEN'T worked
  he has not worked         he HASN'T worked
  she has not worked        she HASN'T worked
  it has not worked         it HASN'T worked
  we have not worked        we HAVEN'T worked
  you have not worked       you HAVEN'T worked
  they have not worked      they HAVEN'T worked


OLTIN QOIDA:
  HAS  →  faqat HE / SHE / IT
  HAVE →  I / YOU / WE / THEY


QISQARTMALAR:
  have  →  'VE      (I've, you've, we've,
                     they've)
  has   →  'S       (he's, she's, it's)
  have not → HAVEN'T
  has not  → HASN'T


⚠ DIQQAT — 'HE'S' UCh MA'NOLI:
  'HE'S worked.'   =  he HAS worked
  'HE'S a doctor.' =  he IS a doctor
  'HE'S working.'  =  he IS working

  Qaysi ekanini KEYINGI SO'Z aytadi:
     keyin V3 kelsa     →  HAS
     keyin ot/sifat     →  IS
     keyin V-ing kelsa  →  IS

  Shu kabi 'IT'S' va 'SHE'S'.


DIQQAT — SO'ROQDA 'DO' KERAK EMAS:
  'Have you worked?'      ✓
  'DO you have worked?'   ✗


DIQQAT — INKORDA 'DON'T' KERAK EMAS:
  'I haven't worked.'     ✓
  'I DON'T have worked.'  ✗


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a regular verb = to'g'ri fe'l
  affirmative    = tasdiq
  interrogative  = so'roq
  negative       = inkor
  long form      = to'liq shakl
  short form     = qisqa shakl

have/has EGADAN OLDIN turadi.
'DO you have worked?' — XATO.

exercises.instructionEn: Present Perfect — Irregular Verb (buy)
exercises.instructionUz: Present Perfect — noto'g'ri fe'l (buy)
exercises.explanationUz:
NOTO'G'RI FE'L: buy → bought → BOUGHT
(bu fe'lda V2 va V3 bir xil, lekin
boshqalarida boshqacha bo'lishi mumkin)


TASDIQ (Affirmative):

  TO'LIQ SHAKL          QISQA SHAKL
  I have bought         I'VE bought
  you have bought       YOU'VE bought
  he has bought         HE'S bought
  she has bought        SHE'S bought
  it has bought         IT'S bought
  we have bought        WE'VE bought
  you have bought       YOU'VE bought
  they have bought      THEY'VE bought


SO'ROQ (Interrogative):

  Have I bought?        Have we bought?
  Have you bought?      Have you bought?
  Has he bought?        Have they bought?
  Has she bought?
  Has it bought?


INKOR (Negative):

  TO'LIQ SHAKL              QISQA SHAKL
  I have not bought         I HAVEN'T bought
  he has not bought         he HASN'T bought
  they have not bought      they HAVEN'T bought
  ...


⚠ ENG MUHIM XULOSA:
  TUZILISH IKKALASIDA HAM BIR XIL!

  Faqat FE'LNING III ShAKLI farq qiladi:
     TO'G'RI:   work  →  WORKED
     NOTO'G'RI: buy   →  BOUGHT

  Qolgan hamma narsa (have/has, so'roq,
  inkor, qisqartma) AYNAN bir xil.


NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR — UCh TUR:

  1) UChALASI HAM BOShQA (ABC):
     see    → saw    → SEEN
     go     → went   → GONE
     eat    → ate    → EATEN
     drive  → drove  → DRIVEN
     ride   → rode   → RIDDEN
     fly    → flew   → FLOWN
     do     → did    → DONE
     be     → was/were → BEEN

  2) V2 va V3 BIR XIL (ABB):
     buy    → bought → BOUGHT
     meet   → met    → MET
     find   → found  → FOUND
     have   → had    → HAD
     make   → made   → MADE
     say    → said   → SAID

  3) UChALASI HAM BIR XIL (AAA):
     cut    → cut    → CUT
     put    → put    → PUT
     let    → let    → LET
     read   → read   → READ
            (yozilishi bir xil, O'QILIShI
             boshqa: /riːd/ → /red/)


DIQQAT — RO'YXAT KITOB OXIRIDA:
  Kitob aytadi: 'See list of irregular verbs
  at the end of the book.'

  Noto'g'ri fe'llar YODLANADI — qoida yo'q.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an irregular verb = noto'g'ri fe'l
  to buy = sotib olmoq (buy → BOUGHT)

exercises.instructionEn: Form and Use
exercises.instructionUz: Yasalishi va ishlatilishi
exercises.explanationUz:
YASALIShI (FORM) — KITOBDAGI BESh QOIDA:

 1 'We form the present perfect with the
    AUXILIARY VERB have/has and the PAST
    PARTICIPLE of the main verb.'
      I HAVE BOUGHT a new dress.

 2 'We form the past participle of REGULAR
    verbs by adding -ED to the verb.'
      watch - watchED
      bury - burIED

 3 'We form the past participle of IRREGULAR
    verbs DIFFERENTLY.'
      buy - BOUGHT

 4 'We form the INTERROGATIVE by putting
    have/has BEFORE THE SUBJECT PRONOUN.'
      HAS HE washed the car?
      HAVE THEY travelled by plane?

 5 'We form the NEGATIVE by putting NOT
    BETWEEN have/has and the past participle.'
      He HAS NOT / HASN'T washed the car.
      They HAVE NOT / HAVEN'T travelled by
      plane.


'-ED' QO'ShISh QOIDALARI (2-band):

  Oddiy:            watch  →  watchED
  Oxiri 'E':        live   →  livED
                    (faqat -D)
  Oxiri UNDOSh+Y:   bury   →  burIED
                    study  →  studIED
                    (y → I + ED)
  Oxiri UNLI+Y:     play   →  playED
                    (y O'ZGARMAYDI!)
  Bir bo'g'in,
  unli+undosh:      stop   →  stopPED
                    (undosh IKKILANADI)

  Kitob ataylab 'bury - buried' misolini
  bergan — 'y' o'zgarishini ko'rsatish uchun.


IShLATILIShI (USE) — KITOBDAGI IKKI QOIDA:

 ⚠ 1) VAQTI AYTILMAGAN harakat:
    'We use the present perfect for actions
     which happened at an UNSTATED TIME in the
     past. The exact time is NOT IMPORTANT.'

      He HAS WASHED the car.
      (When did he wash it? WE DON'T KNOW
       when; the time is NOT MENTIONED.)

    Bu — Coursebook 106-betda o'rganilgan
    qoida.


 ⚠ 2) O'TMIShDA BOShLANIB, HOZIR HAM DAVOM
    ETAYOTGAN harakat:
    'We ALSO use the present perfect for
     actions which STARTED IN THE PAST and are
     STILL CONTINUING IN THE PRESENT.'

      I HAVE KNOWN Tom for 5 years.
      (5 yil oldin tanishganman va HOZIR HAM
       tanishman.)

    ⚠ BU YANGI QOIDA — Coursebook'da
    to'liq berilmagan!


IKKI QO'LLANIShNI SOLIShTIRING:

  1) 'He has washed the car.'
     → ish TUGAGAN, lekin qachonligi noma'lum
     → natijasi HOZIR ko'rinadi (mashina toza)

  2) 'I have known Tom for 5 years.'
     → ish HALI DAVOM etyapti
     → 5 yil oldin boshlangan, hozir ham
       davom etadi

  Ikkinchi qo'llanishda odatda FOR yoki
  SINCE bo'ladi:
     'I've lived here FOR ten years.'
     'She's worked here SINCE 2010.'


⚠ O'ZBEK TILIDA FARQ:
  'I have known Tom for 5 years.'
  O'zbekchada: 'Tomni 5 yildan beri
  BILAMAN' (hozirgi zamon!)

  Ingliz tilida esa PRESENT PERFECT.
  Bu — o'zbek tilidan farq qiladigan joy,
  shuning uchun ko'p xato qilinadi:
     'I know Tom for 5 years.'      ✗
     'I have known Tom for 5 years.' ✓


VAQT RAVIShLARI (kitobdan):
  'Time adverbs used with the present
   perfect: SINCE, FOR, JUST, ALREADY, YET,
   NEVER, EVER.'

  Yetti so'z — hammasi Coursebook 106-107
  betlarida o'rganilgan.


DIQQAT — 'AUXILIARY VERB':
  'auxiliary verb' = yordamchi fe'l
  ('have/has' bu yerda o'z ma'nosini
   yo'qotgan — faqat zamon yasaydi)

  Solishtiring:
     'I HAVE a car.'      — asosiy fe'l
                            (menda mashina bor)
     'I HAVE bought a car.' — yordamchi fe'l


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an auxiliary verb = yordamchi fe'l
  a past participle = fe'lning III shakli
  a subject pronoun = ega olmoshi
  unstated          = aytilmagan
  exact             = aniq
  to mention        = tilga olmoq
  to continue       = davom etmoq
  to bury           = ko'mmoq
  to wash           = yuvmoq

tasks.en: Form and Use
tasks.uz: Yasalishi va ishlatilishi

tasks.en: We form the present perfect with the auxiliary verb have/has and the past participle of the main verb.  —  I have bought a new dress.
tasks.uz: Present Perfect ni yordamchi fe'l have/has va asosiy fe'lning III shakli bilan yasaymiz. — Yangi ko'ylak sotib oldim.
tasks.note:
'auxiliary verb' = yordamchi fe'l.
Bu yerda 'have' o'z ma'nosini yo'qotgan —
faqat zamon yasaydi.

tasks.en: We form the past participle of regular verbs by adding -ed to the verb.  —  watch - watched, bury - buried
tasks.uz: To'g'ri fe'llarning III shaklini fe'lga -ED qo'shib yasaymiz. — watch-watched, bury-buried
tasks.note:
DIQQAT — 'bury → burIED':
undoshdan keyingi 'Y' → I + ED.
Lekin unlidan keyin o'zgarmaydi:
'play → playED'.

tasks.en: We form the past participle of irregular verbs differently. (See list of irregular verbs at the end of the book.)  —  buy - bought
tasks.uz: Noto'g'ri fe'llarning III shaklini boshqacha yasaymiz. (Ro'yxat kitob oxirida.) — buy-bought
tasks.note: Noto'g'ri fe'llar YODLANADI — qoida yo'q.

tasks.en: We form the interrogative by putting have/has before the subject pronoun.  —  Has he washed the car? Have they travelled by plane?
tasks.uz: So'roq shaklini have/has ni ega olmoshidan oldin qo'yib yasaymiz. — U mashinani yuvganmi? Ular samolyotda uchishganmi?
tasks.note:
'DO' KERAK EMAS.
'travelled' — britancha (IKKI 'L').

tasks.en: We form the negative by putting not between have/has and the past participle.  —  He hasn't washed the car.
tasks.uz: Inkor shaklini have/has va III shakl orasiga 'not' qo'yib yasaymiz. — U mashinani yuvmagan.
tasks.note: 'DON'T' KERAK EMAS.

tasks.en: We use the present perfect for actions which happened at an unstated time in the past. The exact time is not important.  —  He has washed the car. (When did he wash it? We don't know when; the time is not mentioned.)
tasks.uz: Present Perfect ni o'tmishda VAQTI AYTILMAGAN holda sodir bo'lgan harakatlar uchun ishlatamiz. Aniq vaqt muhim emas. — U mashinani yuvgan. (Qachon yuvgani noma'lum.)
tasks.note:
⚠ 1-QO'LLANISH — Coursebook 106-betda
o'rganilgan.

tasks.en: We also use the present perfect for actions which started in the past and are still continuing in the present.  —  I have known Tom for 5 years.
tasks.uz: Present Perfect ni o'tmishda boshlanib, hozir ham davom etayotgan harakatlar uchun ham ishlatamiz. — Tomni 5 yildan beri bilaman.
tasks.note:
⚠ 2-QO'LLANISH — YANGI QOIDA!
Coursebook'da to'liq berilmagan.

O'ZBEK TILIDAN FARQI: o'zbekchada HOZIRGI
zamon ('bilaman'), inglizchada PRESENT
PERFECT.
'I KNOW Tom for 5 years' — XATO!

tasks.en: Time adverbs used with the present perfect: since, for, just, already, yet, never, ever.
tasks.uz: Present Perfect bilan ishlatiladigan vaqt ravishlari: since, for, just, already, yet, never, ever.
tasks.note:
Yetti so'z — hammasi Coursebook 106-107
betlarida o'rganilgan.

sections.title: Nazariya — Past Simple, ever/never, just, yet/already, for/since, gone/been
sections.titleUz: Nazariya — Past Simple, ever/never, just, yet/already, for/since, gone/been

exercises.instructionEn: Past Simple
exercises.instructionUz: Past Simple
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use the PAST SIMPLE for an action which
    happened at a STATED TIME in the past.'
      They TRAVELLED to France LAST SUMMER.
      (When? Last summer. The time IS
       MENTIONED.)

 • 'Time adverbs used with the past simple:
    YESTERDAY, TWO/THREE etc DAYS/MONTHS etc
    AGO, LAST MONDAY/WEEK/MONTH, etc.'


⚠ PRESENT PERFECT BILAN FARQI:

  PRESENT PERFECT — vaqt AYTILMAGAN
     'He HAS WASHED the car.'
     (qachonligi noma'lum)

  PAST SIMPLE — vaqt AYTILGAN
     'They TRAVELLED to France LAST SUMMER.'
     (qachon? — o'tgan yozda)

  Bu — butun Unit 15 ning o'zagi.


PAST SIMPLE VAQT RAVIShLARI:
  yesterday          (kecha)
  two days ago       (ikki kun oldin)
  three months ago   (uch oy oldin)
  last Monday        (o'tgan dushanba)
  last week          (o'tgan hafta)
  last month         (o'tgan oy)
  last summer        (o'tgan yozda)
  in 2010            (2010-yilda)
  when I was a child (bolaligimda)


⚠ ENG KO'P XATO:
  'I have seen him YESTERDAY.'      ✗
  'I SAW him yesterday.'            ✓

  'They have travelled LAST SUMMER.' ✗
  'They TRAVELLED last summer.'      ✓


DIQQAT — 'AGO' va 'FOR':
  'two days AGO'  → PAST SIMPLE
     'I arrived two days ago.'
  'FOR two days'  → PRESENT PERFECT
     'I've been here for two days.'

  Ikkalasi ham 'ikki kun', lekin zamonlari
  BOSHQA.


DIQQAT — 'TRAVELLED':
  Britancha: travelLED (IKKI 'L')
  Amerikacha: traveLED (bitta 'L')
  Enterprise — britancha kitob.

tasks.en: Past Simple
tasks.uz: Past Simple

tasks.en: We use the past simple for an action which happened at a stated time in the past.  —  They travelled to France last summer. (When? Last summer. The time is mentioned.)
tasks.uz: Past Simple ni o'tmishda VAQTI AYTILGAN holda sodir bo'lgan harakat uchun ishlatamiz. — Ular o'tgan yozda Fransiyaga sayohat qilishdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'STATED TIME' = aytilgan vaqt.
Present Perfect esa 'UNSTATED TIME'
(64-bet).

tasks.en: Time adverbs used with the past simple: yesterday, two/three etc days/months etc ago, last Monday/week/month, etc.
tasks.uz: Past Simple bilan ishlatiladigan vaqt ravishlari: yesterday, two/three kun/oy oldin, last Monday/week/month va h.k.
tasks.note:
'AGO' — DOIM Past Simple bilan.
'FOR' — Present Perfect bilan (adashtirmang!).

exercises.instructionEn: Ever/Never and Just
exercises.instructionUz: Ever/Never va Just
exercises.explanationUz:
EVER / NEVER — KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use EVER in questions and statements.'
      Have you EVER visited Prague?
      Madrid is the best city I've EVER
      visited.

 • 'We use NEVER in statements.'
      I've NEVER visited America.
      (= I HAVEN'T visited America.)


'EVER' IKKI HOLATDA:
  1) SAVOLDA — 'hech qachon ...ganmisiz?'
        'Have you EVER visited Prague?'
  2) USTUN DARAJA bilan — 'ko'rgan eng ...'
        'Madrid is the BEST city I've EVER
         visited.'


'NEVER' — O'ZI INKOR:
     'I've NEVER visited America.'   ✓
     'I haven't NEVER visited.'      ✗ XATO!

  Kitob ikki xil aytish mumkinligini
  ko'rsatadi:
     'I've NEVER visited America.'
     'I HAVEN'T visited America.'
  Ma'nosi bir xil, lekin 'never' KUCHLIROQ.


O'RNI: 'have' va V3 ORASIDA
     'Have you EVER visited ...?'
     'I've NEVER visited ...'


─────────────────────────────────────

JUST — KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use JUST in statements to show that an
    action finished only A FEW MINUTES
    EARLIER.'
      A: Have you finished your homework?
      B: Yes, I've JUST finished it.


'JUST' = hozirgina, endigina
  Harakat bir necha DAQIQA oldin tugagan.

O'RNI: 'have' va V3 ORASIDA
     'I've JUST finished it.'  ✓
     'I've finished it JUST.'  ✗


DIQQAT — 'JUST' NING BOShQA MA'NOSI:
  'just' — faqat, shunchaki:
     'It's JUST a joke.' (shunchaki hazil)
  Present Perfect bilan esa 'hozirgina'.

tasks.en: Ever/Never and Just
tasks.uz: Ever/Never va Just

tasks.en: We use ever in questions and statements.  —  Have you ever visited Prague? Madrid is the best city I've ever visited.
tasks.uz: EVER ni savol va darak gaplarda ishlatamiz. — Pragaga borganmisiz? Madrid — men borgan eng yaxshi shahar.
tasks.note:
IKKI HOLAT: savolda; ustun daraja bilan.
O'rni: 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.

tasks.en: We use never in statements.  —  I've never visited America. (= I haven't visited America.)
tasks.uz: NEVER ni darak gaplarda ishlatamiz. — Amerikaga hech qachon bormaganman.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'never' O'ZI INKOR:
'I haven't never visited' — XATO!
Ikki xil aytish mumkin: 'I've NEVER visited'
yoki 'I HAVEN'T visited'.

tasks.en: We use just in statements to show that an action finished only a few minutes earlier.  —  A: Have you finished your homework?  B: Yes, I've just finished it.
tasks.uz: JUST ni harakat bir necha daqiqa oldin tugaganini ko'rsatish uchun darak gaplarda ishlatamiz. — A: Uy vazifangni tugatdingmi? B: Ha, hozirgina tugatdim.
tasks.note:
'just' = hozirgina.
O'rni: 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.

exercises.instructionEn: Yet/Already and For/Since
exercises.instructionUz: Yet/Already va For/Since
exercises.explanationUz:
YET / ALREADY — KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use ALREADY in STATEMENTS and
    QUESTIONS.'
      Have you done the washing up ALREADY?
      Yes, I have. I've ALREADY done it.

 • 'We use YET in QUESTIONS and NEGATIVES.'
      Have you done the ironing YET?
      No, I haven't. I haven't done the
      ironing YET.


⚠ DIQQAT — 'ALREADY' SAVOLDA HAM BO'LADI:
  Coursebook 106-betda faqat 'tasdiqda'
  deyilgan edi, Grammar Book esa
  'statements AND QUESTIONS' deydi.

  Farqi MA'NODA:
     'Have you done it YET?'
        = oddiy savol (qildingmi?)
     'Have you done it ALREADY?'
        = AJABLANISH (allaqachonmi?
          shunchalik tezmi?)


O'RNI:
  ALREADY — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA
     'I've ALREADY done it.'
     (savolda esa gap oxirida ham bo'ladi:
      'Have you done it ALREADY?')

  YET — DOIM GAP OXIRIDA
     'Have you done the ironing YET?'
     'I haven't done the ironing YET.'


UY IShLARI LUG'ATI (kitob misollaridan):
  'the washing up' = idish yuvish
  'the ironing'    = dazmollash
  'the washing'    = kir yuvish
  'the shopping'   = xarid

  Hammasi 'DO' fe'li bilan:
     do the washing up / the ironing /
     the shopping


─────────────────────────────────────

FOR / SINCE — KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use FOR to express DURATION.'
      I've worked here FOR seven years.

 • 'We use SINCE to state a STARTING POINT.'
      I've worked here SINCE 1992.


ENG ODDIY FARQ:
  FOR   + QANChA VAQT
          for seven years, for three days,
          for a long time
  SINCE + QAChONDAN BERI
          since 1992, since Monday,
          since last week

  Savol bering: 'qancha vaqt?' → FOR
                'qachondan beri?' → SINCE


DIQQAT — IKKALA MISOL HAM BIR XIL GAP:
  'I've worked here FOR seven years.'
  'I've worked here SINCE 1992.'

  Agar hozir 1999-yil bo'lsa, ikkalasi ham
  bir xil ma'no beradi — faqat boshqacha
  aytilgan!

tasks.en: Yet/Already and For/Since
tasks.uz: Yet/Already va For/Since

tasks.en: We use already in statements and questions.  —  Have you done the washing up already? Yes, I have. I've already done it.
tasks.uz: ALREADY ni darak va so'roq gaplarda ishlatamiz. — Idishlarni allaqachon yuvdingmi? Ha. Allaqachon yuvdim.
tasks.note:
⚠ Grammar Book 'savolda ham' deydi.
Savolda 'already' — AJABLANISH ma'nosi
(shunchalik tezmi?).

tasks.en: We use yet in questions and negatives.  —  Have you done the ironing yet? No, I haven't. I haven't done the ironing yet.
tasks.uz: YET ni so'roq va inkor gaplarda ishlatamiz. — Dazmollab bo'ldingmi? Yo'q, hali dazmollamadim.
tasks.note:
'yet' — DOIM GAP OXIRIDA.
'the ironing' = dazmollash.

tasks.en: We use for to express duration.  —  I've worked here for seven years.
tasks.uz: FOR ni davomiylikni bildirish uchun ishlatamiz. — Bu yerda yetti yildan beri ishlayman.
tasks.note: FOR + QANCHA VAQT.

tasks.en: We use since to state a starting point.  —  I've worked here since 1992.
tasks.uz: SINCE ni boshlanish nuqtasini aytish uchun ishlatamiz. — Bu yerda 1992-yildan beri ishlayman.
tasks.note:
SINCE + QACHONDAN BERI.

DIQQAT: ikkala misol AYNI BIR gapni ikki xil
aytish (agar hozir 1999 bo'lsa).

exercises.instructionEn: Have gone (to) - Have been (to)
exercises.instructionUz: Have gone (to) - Have been (to)
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ BU BETDAGI ENG MUHIM QOIDA

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:
  'There are TWO WAYS to form the present
   perfect of the verb GO: HAVE GONE and
   HAVE BEEN, but there is a DIFFERENCE IN
   MEANING.'

  MISOLLAR:

  'Bob and Marie HAVE GONE to Rome.'
     (They went to Rome some time ago and
      they are STILL THERE.)

  'I HAVE BEEN to Rome.'
     (I have visited Rome and COME BACK.
      I am NOT there now.)


ENG ODDIY FARQ:

  HAVE GONE TO  →  KETGAN va HALI U YERDA
     'He has gone to Rome.'
     = U Rimga ketgan (hozir Rimda)

  HAVE BEEN TO  →  BORIB QAYTGAN
     'He has been to Rome.'
     = U Rimda bo'lgan (hozir bu yerda)


QANDAY ESLAB QOLISh:

  GONE — odam YO'Q (ketgan)
  BEEN — odam BOR (qaytgan)

  Yoki:
     'gone' = ketish (harakati)
     'been' = bo'lish (tajribasi)


ShUNING UChUN:

  'I HAVE GONE to Rome.'  — deyarli
     ISHLATILMAYDI! (chunki agar Rimda
     bo'lsangiz, bu gapni aytolmaysiz)

  'I HAVE BEEN to Rome.'  ✓
     (tajriba haqida)

  Ya'ni O'ZINGIZ haqingizda deyarli doim
  'BEEN' ishlatasiz.


MISOLLAR YONMA-YON:

  'Where's Tom?' — 'He HAS GONE to the shops.'
     (do'konda, hali qaytmagan)

  'Have you ever been to Paris?' —
  'Yes, I HAVE BEEN there twice.'
     (borgan va qaytgan)

  'My parents HAVE GONE to Turkey.'
     (hozir Turkiyada)

  'My parents HAVE BEEN to Turkey.'
     (borishgan va qaytishgan)


BOG'LIQLIK — COURSEBOOK:
  104-bet, 1-mashq:
     'Have you ever BEEN there?'
  106-bet, 11-mashq:
     'I've BEEN to Spain.'
     'I've never BEEN to China.'
  107-bet, 16-mashq:
     'Have you BEEN to Palacio Real yet?'
     (Pol borib qaytgan, shuning uchun 'been')

  Coursebook'da deyarli doim 'been'
  ishlatilgan — endi nega ekani ma'lum.


DIQQAT — PREDLOG:
  'have been TO Rome'   ✓ (borgan)
  'have been IN Rome'   — boshqa ma'no
     ('Rimda bo'lganman' — ichkarida,
      masalan 'I've been in Rome for a week')

  'have gone TO Rome'   ✓


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a difference in meaning = ma'no farqi
  still     = hali ham
  to come back = qaytmoq

exercises.instructionEn: Expand the prompts into sentences using for or since, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalarni for yoki since bilan to'liq gaplarga aylantiring, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  She has lived in Brazil SINCE 1992.
    (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)
 2  He has been ill FOR three days.
 3  They haven't visited their grandparents
    SINCE last month.
 4  I have been a policeman FOR twenty years.
 5  Karen hasn't been home SINCE October.
 6  He hasn't travelled by boat SINCE last
    summer.
 7  I haven't been to Paris FOR six years.
 8  Jack has worked in Canada FOR ten years.
 9  She hasn't been abroad FOR two years.
10  Jeff hasn't called SINCE Monday.


FOR yoki SINCE — TAQSIMOT:

  FOR (davomiylik) — 2, 4, 7, 8, 9:
     three days, twenty years, six years,
     ten years, two years

  SINCE (nuqta) — 1, 3, 5, 6, 10:
     1992, last month, October,
     last summer, Monday

  Ya'ni beshtadan teng!


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — OXIRGI QISMGA QARANG:

  RAQAM + vaqt birligi  →  FOR
     'three days', 'twenty years'

  YIL, OY, KUN, 'last ...'  →  SINCE
     '1992', 'October', 'Monday',
     'last month', 'last summer'


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
 1  U 1992-yildan beri Braziliyada yashaydi.
 2  U uch kundan beri kasal.
 3  Ular o'tgan oydan beri buvilarinikiga
    bormagan.
 4  Men yigirma yildan beri militsionerman.
 5  Karen oktyabrdan beri uyda bo'lmagan.
 6  U o'tgan yozdan beri qayiqda sayohat
    qilmagan.
 7  Olti yildan beri Parijga bormaganman.
 8  Jek o'n yildan beri Kanadada ishlaydi.
 9  U ikki yildan beri chet elga chiqmagan.
10  Jeff dushanbadan beri qo'ng'iroq qilmagan.


HAR BIRIDA NIMA QO'ShILADI:

  1) HAVE / HAS
     ega III shaxs birlik → HAS
     (1, 2, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10-bandlar)
     qolganlarida → HAVE
     (3, 4, 7-bandlar)

  2) FE'LNING III ShAKLI (V3):
     live   → LIVED
     be     → BEEN
     visit  → VISITED
     travel → TRAVELLED
     go     → BEEN (quyiga qarang!)
     work   → WORKED
     call   → CALLED

  3) 'NOT' bo'lsa → HAVEN'T / HASN'T
     (3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10-bandlar)

  4) FOR yoki SINCE


⚠ 7-BAND HAQIDA MUHIM IZOH:

  'I/not go/to Paris/six years'

  Javob: 'I HAVEN'T BEEN to Paris for six
         years.'

  NEGA 'BEEN', 'GONE' EMAS?
  Bu betdagi grammatika qutisi tushuntiradi:
     'have GONE to' = ketgan va HALI U YERDA
     'have BEEN to' = borib QAYTGAN

  'I haven't GONE to Paris' — g'alati
  (o'zim haqimda 'gone' ishlatilmaydi).
  'I haven't BEEN to Paris' ✓

  Kitob ataylab shu bandni qo'ygan — yangi
  qoidani sinash uchun.


DIQQAT — 5 va 9-BANDLARDAGI 'BE':
  5  'Karen hasn't BEEN home since October.'
  9  'She hasn't BEEN abroad for two years.'

  Bu yerda 'be' — 'bo'lmoq' ma'nosida
  (harakat emas).

  'be HOME' — predlog YO'Q
     ('be at home' ham to'g'ri)
  'be ABROAD' — predlog YO'Q
     ('go abroad' = chet elga chiqmoq)


DIQQAT — 2 va 4-BANDLARDAGI 'BE':
  2  'He has BEEN ill for three days.'
     = uch kundan beri kasal (HOZIR HAM)
  4  'I have BEEN a policeman for twenty
     years.'
     = yigirma yildan beri militsionerman
       (HOZIR HAM)

  Bu — 64-betdagi IKKINCHI qo'llanish:
  o'tmishda boshlanib, HOZIR HAM davom
  etayotgan holat.

  O'zbekchada HOZIRGI zamon bilan tarjima
  qilinadi!


DIQQAT — 'TRAVELLED' (6-band):
  Britancha: travelLED (IKKI 'L')
  Amerikacha: traveLED


DIQQAT — 'BY BOAT' (6-band):
  'travel BY boat / BY plane / BY car'
  Transport 'BY' bilan, ARTIKLSIZ.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  ill          = kasal
  grandparents = bobo-buvi
  a policeman  = militsioner
  abroad       = chet elda
  to call      = qo'ng'iroq qilmoq
  by boat      = qayiqda

exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL — UCh EGA, TO'RT ISh:

            go to  eat     travel  take a
            the    Mexican to      boat
            opera  food    Europe  trip
  ────────  ─────  ──────  ──────  ──────
  Tom         ✗      ✓       ✓       ✗
  Andrea      ✓      ✗       ✗       ✓
  The Smiths  ✓      ✗       ✓       ✗


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA (Tom):

  'Tom HASN'T BEEN to the opera, BUT he HAS
   EATEN Mexican food. He HAS ALSO TRAVELLED
   to Europe, BUT he HASN'T TAKEN a boat trip.'


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 ANDREA:
  'Andrea HAS BEEN to the opera, BUT she
   HASN'T EATEN Mexican food. She HASN'T
   TRAVELLED to Europe, BUT she HAS TAKEN a
   boat trip.'

  Tarjimasi: Andrea operaga borgan, lekin
  meksika taomini yeb ko'rmagan. U Yevropaga
  sayohat qilmagan, lekin qayiqda sayohat
  qilgan.


 THE SMITHS:
  'The Smiths HAVE BEEN to the opera, BUT they
   HAVEN'T EATEN Mexican food. They HAVE
   TRAVELLED to Europe, BUT they HAVEN'T TAKEN
   a boat trip.'

  Tarjimasi: Smitlar operaga borishgan, lekin
  meksika taomini yeb ko'rishmagan. Ular
  Yevropaga sayohat qilishgan, lekin qayiqda
  sayohat qilishmagan.


⚠ UCh MUHIM NUQTA:

 1) 'GO TO THE OPERA' → 'HAVE BEEN TO':
    Namuna 'Tom hasn't BEEN to the opera'
    deydi, 'hasn't GONE' emas!

    Chunki bu betdagi qoida:
       'have BEEN to' = borib qaytgan
                        (TAJRIBA)
       'have GONE to' = hali u yerda

    Jadvalda TAJRIBA haqida so'ralyapti,
    shuning uchun DOIM 'been'.

 2) 'THE SMITHS' — KO'PLIK:
    'The Smiths HAVE been ...'  ✓
    'The Smiths HAS been ...'   ✗

    'the Smiths' = Smitlar (butun oila),
    shuning uchun KO'PLIK va olmoshi 'THEY'.

    (Workbook 53-betda ham shu haqda edi:
     'the SmithS' house' — apostrof o'rni.)

 3) 'BUT' NING O'RNI:
    Namuna har ikki ishni 'BUT' bilan
    bog'laydi:
       [1-ish], BUT [2-ish].
       [3-ish], BUT [4-ish].

    Chunki har juftlikda biri ✓, biri ✗.


V3 ShAKLLARI (jadvaldagi fe'llar):
  go     →  went     →  BEEN / GONE
  eat    →  ate      →  EATEN
  travel →  travelled →  TRAVELLED
  take   →  took     →  TAKEN

  DIQQAT: 'eaten', 'taken' — '-EN' bilan.


OLMOShLAR:
  Tom        →  HE   →  has
  Andrea     →  SHE  →  has
  The Smiths →  THEY →  have


DIQQAT — 'ALSO' NING O'RNI:
  Namunada: 'He HAS ALSO TRAVELLED to Europe'
  'also' — 'has' va V3 ORASIDA.

  Xuddi 'already', 'just', 'never' kabi.

  Andrea uchun 'also' kerak emas, chunki
  uning uchinchi ishi ✗ (inkor).


DIQQAT — 'MEXICAN FOOD':
  Millat sifatlari BOSH HARF bilan:
     Mexican food, Chinese food,
     Italian food, Turkish coffee


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the opera    = opera
  Mexican food = meksika taomi
  Europe       = Yevropa
  to take a boat trip = qayiqda sayohat qilmoq
  the Smiths   = Smitlar (oila)

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct word.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri so'zning tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  ALREADY      9  NEVER
   2  FOR         10  EVER
   3  JUST        11  FOR
   4  NEVER       12  YET
   5  EVER        13  SINCE
   6  YET         14  JUST
   7  SINCE       15  NEVER
   8  ALREADY


UCh OLTIN QOIDA — HAMMASINI HAL QILADI:

  A) GAP TASDIQMI, INKORMI, SAVOLMI?
     TASDIQ  →  already, just, never
     INKOR   →  yet
     SAVOL   →  yet, ever

  B) 'FOR' MI, 'SINCE' MI?
     raqam + vaqt birligi  →  FOR
     yil, oy, kun, 'last'  →  SINCE

  C) 'EVER' MI, 'NEVER' MI?
     SAVOLDA yoki USTUN DARAJA bilan → EVER
     TASDIQ gapda (inkor ma'no)      → NEVER


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  'YES, we have ... visited the Statue of
     Liberty.'
    KALIT: 'YES' — gap IJOBIY.
    'never' inkor ma'no berardi.
    → ALREADY

 2  'a teacher ... thirty years'
    'thirty years' — DAVOMIYLIK.
    → FOR

 3  'Yes, I have ... called her.'
    'ever' tasdiq gapda ishlatilmaydi.
    'just' = hozirgina — mos.
    → JUST

 4  'NO, I have ... been to Egypt.'
    KALIT: 'NO' — gap SALBIY.
    'have never been' = bormaganman.
    → NEVER

 5  'HAVE YOU ... been to a football match?'
    KALIT: bu SAVOL.
    Savolda 'ever' ishlatiladi.
    → EVER

 6  'I HAVEN'T finished my homework ...'
    KALIT: INKOR gap.
    'already' inkorda ishlatilmaydi.
    → YET

 7  'in Rio ... 1984'
    '1984' — YIL, ANIQ NUQTA.
    → SINCE

 8  'They have ... bought a computer.'
    TASDIQ gap.
    'yet' tasdiqda ishlatilmaydi.
    → ALREADY

 9  'Tracy has ... seen snow.'
    TASDIQ shakldagi gap, lekin ma'no
    INKOR (qorni ko'rmagan).
    'ever' tasdiq oddiy gapda ishlatilmaydi.
    → NEVER

10  'Cairo is the BEST place I've ... visited.'
    KALIT: 'THE BEST' — USTUN DARAJA.
    Bu qurilmada DOIM 'ever'.
    → EVER

11  'at university ... three years'
    'three years' — DAVOMIYLIK.
    ('already' bu yerda mos kelmaydi —
     u vaqt miqdorini bildirmaydi.)
    → FOR

12  'The boat ... HASN'T LEFT ...'
    KALIT: INKOR gap.
    → YET

13  'Gary hasn't been abroad ... last summer.'
    'last summer' — ANIQ NUQTA.
    → SINCE

14  'Yes, I have ... packed it.'
    'since' bu yerda ma'nosiz.
    'just' = hozirgina — mos.
    → JUST

15  'I have ... travelled by train.'
    TASDIQ shakl, INKOR ma'no.
    → NEVER


⚠ 9 va 15-BANDLAR — ENG NOZIK:
  Gap TASDIQ shaklda ('has seen', 'have
  travelled'), lekin ma'no INKOR.

  'Tracy has NEVER seen snow.'
     = Treysi qorni hech qachon ko'rmagan

  'ever' bu yerda XATO, chunki 'ever' faqat
  savolda yoki ustun daraja bilan keladi.


⚠ 10-BAND — USTUN DARAJA QURILMASI:
  'the BEST place I've EVER visited'
  Bu qurilmada 'ever' TASDIQ gapda keladi —
  yagona holat.

  Coursebook 106-bet: 'Brazil is the best
  place I've ever visited.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the Statue of Liberty = Ozodlik haykali
  a football match = futbol o'yini
  Rio  = Rio-de-Janeyro
  Malta = Malta
  abroad = chet elda
  a suitcase = chamadon
  by train = poyezdda

tasks.whyUz:

Savolda DOIM 'ever' ishlatiladi.

mumkin, lekin ajablanish ohangi (juda kam).

tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'HAVEN'T' — INKOR gap.

'yet' — savol va inkorda, GAP OXIRIDA.

tasks.prompt: 7  She has lived in Rio for/since 1984.
tasks.whyUz:
'1984' — YIL, ya'ni ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE.

Savol: 'qachondan beri?' → 1984-yildan.

tasks.prompt: 8  They have already/yet bought a computer.
tasks.whyUz:
TASDIQ gap ('They have bought').

'yet' TASDIQ gapda ishlatilmaydi.
'already' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.

tasks.prompt: 9  Tracy has never/ever seen snow.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ NOZIK BAND: gap TASDIQ shaklda
('has seen'), lekin ma'no INKOR.

'never' TASDIQ shaklda inkor ma'no beradi.
'ever' oddiy tasdiq gapda ISHLATILMAYDI.

tasks.prompt: 10  Cairo is the best place I've never/ever visited.
tasks.promptUz: Qohira — men borgan eng yaxshi joy.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'THE BEST' — USTUN DARAJA.

Bu qurilmada DOIM 'ever':
'the best place I've EVER visited'

Coursebook 106-bet: 'Brazil is the best place
I've ever visited.'

Bu — 'ever' TASDIQ gapda keladigan yagona
holat.

tasks.prompt: 11  I have been at university already/for three years.
tasks.whyUz:
'three years' — DAVOMIYLIK → FOR.

'already' vaqt MIQDORINI bildirmaydi,
shuning uchun 'three years' bilan mos
kelmaydi.

'at university' — artikl YO'Q (o'qish
ma'nosida).

tasks.prompt: 12  The boat to Malta hasn't left yet/already.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'HASN'T' — INKOR gap.

'yet' — inkorda, GAP OXIRIDA.
leave → LEFT (V2 = V3).

tasks.prompt: 13  Gary hasn't been abroad for/since last summer.
tasks.promptUz: Gari o'tgan yozdan beri chet elga chiqmagan.
tasks.whyUz:
'last summer' — ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE.

DIQQAT — CHALG'ITUVCHI:
  'FOR a summer'      (davomiylik)
  'SINCE last summer' (nuqta)
'last' so'zi kalit.

tasks.prompt: 14  A: Have you packed your suitcase?  B: Yes, I have just/since packed it.
tasks.whyUz:
'since' — predlog, undan keyin vaqt kelishi
kerak ('since Monday'). Bu yerda ma'nosiz.

'just' = hozirgina — savolga mos javob.

Coursebook 107-bet, 14-mashq bilan bir xil
naqsh.

tasks.prompt: 15  I have never/ever travelled by train.
tasks.whyUz:
9-band bilan bir xil: TASDIQ shakl, INKOR
ma'no → NEVER.

'ever' oddiy tasdiq gapda ISHLATILMAYDI.

'BY train' — transport 'by' bilan, artiklsiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present perfect or past simple, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavs ichidagi fe'llarni present perfect yoki past simple ga qo'ying, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh DIALOG — BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  A: HAVE YOU EVER BEEN to a circus?
       (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)
    B: Yes, I WENT to one last year.
    A: DID YOU HAVE a good time?
    B: Oh yes! I HAD a lot of fun.

 2  A: DID YOU GO to the theatre last night?
    B: Yes, I SAW an excellent play.
    A: What DID YOU SEE?
    B: Romeo and Juliet.

 3  A: HAVE YOU DONE the shopping yet?
    B: Yes, I DID it this morning.
    A: HAVE YOU WASHED the car yet?
    B: Yes, I HAVE ALREADY WASHED it.

 4  A: HAVE YOU EVER EATEN Chinese food?
    B: Yes, I ATE Chinese food last month.
    A: DID YOU LIKE it?
    B: No, it TASTED terrible.

 5  A: HAVE YOU EVER WORKED in a bar?
    B: Yes, I WORKED in a bar last summer.
    A: DID YOU ENJOY it?
    B: Yes, I ENJOYED it very much!


⚠ BUTUN MAShQNING NAQShI — BIR XIL:

  1-savol:  PRESENT PERFECT (tajriba)
            'Have you EVER ...?'
            yoki 'Have you ... YET?'
  1-javob:  PAST SIMPLE (aniq vaqt qo'shiladi)
            'Yes, I ... LAST YEAR / THIS
             MORNING / LAST MONTH.'
  2-savol:  PAST SIMPLE (o'sha voqea haqida)
            'DID you ...?'
  2-javob:  PAST SIMPLE

  Ya'ni: birinchi savol UMUMIY (Present
  Perfect), keyin suhbat O'SHA VOQEAGA
  o'tadi va PAST SIMPLE bo'ladi.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'Have you ever BEEN to a circus?'
       'ever' → PRESENT PERFECT
       'go' → BEEN (borib qaytgan)
    'I WENT to one LAST YEAR.'
       'last year' → PAST SIMPLE
    'DID YOU HAVE a good time?'
       o'sha safar haqida → PAST SIMPLE
    'I HAD a lot of fun.'
       PAST SIMPLE

 2  'DID YOU GO to the theatre LAST NIGHT?'
       'last night' → PAST SIMPLE
    'I SAW an excellent play.'
       PAST SIMPLE (see → SAW)
    'What DID YOU SEE?'
       PAST SIMPLE savoli
       DIQQAT: 'did' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl!

 3  'HAVE YOU DONE the shopping YET?'
       'yet' → PRESENT PERFECT
    'I DID it THIS MORNING.'
       'this morning' → PAST SIMPLE
       (ertalab tugagan)
    'HAVE YOU WASHED the car YET?'
       'yet' → PRESENT PERFECT
    'I HAVE ALREADY WASHED it.'
       'already' → PRESENT PERFECT

 4  'Have you ever EATEN Chinese food?'
       'ever' → PRESENT PERFECT
       eat → EATEN
    'I ATE Chinese food LAST MONTH.'
       'last month' → PAST SIMPLE
    'DID YOU LIKE it?'
       PAST SIMPLE
    'It TASTED terrible.'
       PAST SIMPLE

 5  'Have you ever WORKED in a bar?'
       'ever' → PRESENT PERFECT
    'I WORKED in a bar LAST SUMMER.'
       'last summer' → PAST SIMPLE
    'DID YOU ENJOY it?'
       PAST SIMPLE
    'I ENJOYED it very much!'
       PAST SIMPLE


⚠ ENG KO'P XATO — 'DID' DAN KEYIN:
  'DID you HAVE a good time?'  ✓
  'DID you HAD a good time?'   ✗
  'What DID you SEE?'          ✓
  'What DID you SAW?'          ✗

  'did' o'zi o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatadi,
  shuning uchun fe'l ASOSIY shaklda qoladi.


DIQQAT — 'TASTE + SIFAT':
  'It TASTED TERRIBLE.'  ✓
  'It tasted terriblY.'  ✗

  His fe'llaridan keyin SIFAT keladi
  (look, smell, taste, sound, feel).


UCh ASOSIY ShAKL (mashqdagi fe'llar):
  go    → went   → BEEN/GONE
  have  → had    → HAD
  see   → saw    → SEEN
  do    → did    → DONE
  wash  → washed → WASHED
  eat   → ate    → EATEN
  like  → liked  → LIKED
  taste → tasted → TASTED
  work  → worked → WORKED
  enjoy → enjoyed → ENJOYED


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a circus      = sirk
  to have a good time = yaxshi vaqt o'tkazmoq
  fun           = zavq, qiziq
  a play        = spektakl
  excellent     = a'lo
  a bar         = bar
  to enjoy      = zavqlanmoq

tasks.promptUz: Ha, o'tgan yili bittasiga borgan edim.
tasks.whyUz:
'LAST YEAR' — ANIQ VAQT → PAST SIMPLE.
go → WENT.

Savol Present Perfect da edi ('Have you ever
been'), lekin javobda aniq vaqt qo'shilgani
uchun Past Simple.

Suhbat endi O'SHA SAFAR haqida ('last year')
→ PAST SIMPLE savoli.

⚠ 'DID' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
  'Did you HAVE?'  ✓
  'Did you HAD?'   ✗

tasks.prompt: 1d  B: Oh yes! I ......................... (have) a lot of fun.
tasks.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE (o'sha safar haqida).
have → HAD.

'to have fun' = zavqlanmoq (turg'un ibora).
tasks.speak: 1d  B: Oh yes! I ......................... (have) a lot of fun.

tasks.prompt: 2a  A: ................................... (you/go) to the theatre last night?
tasks.whyUz:
'LAST NIGHT' — ANIQ VAQT → PAST SIMPLE.

DIQQAT: bu dialogda BIRINCHI savol ham Past
Simple da — chunki aniq vaqt aytilgan.
(1, 3, 4, 5-dialoglarda birinchi savol Present
Perfect edi.)
tasks.speak: 2a  A: ................................... (you/go) to the theatre last night?

tasks.prompt: 2b  B: Yes, I ......................... (see) an excellent play.
tasks.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE (o'tgan kecha).
see → SAW.

'a play' = spektakl.
'excellent' = a'lo.
tasks.speak: 2b  B: Yes, I ......................... (see) an excellent play.

tasks.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE savoli: DID + ega + ASOSIY shakl.

⚠ 'What did you SEE?'  ✓
   'What did you SAW?'  ✗

'did' o'zi o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatadi.

KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT.
do → DONE (V3).

'do the shopping' = xarid qilmoq.

'THIS MORNING' — ANIQ VAQT → PAST SIMPLE.
do → DID.

DIQQAT: 'this morning' allaqachon TUGAGAN
(hozir kunduz yoki kechqurun), shuning uchun
Past Simple.

KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT.
wash → WASHED (to'g'ri fe'l).

Grammar 64-betdagi misol bilan bir xil:
'Has he washed the car?'

KALIT: 'ALREADY' → PRESENT PERFECT.

'already' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA:
'I HAVE ALREADY WASHED it.' ✓

KALIT: 'EVER' → PRESENT PERFECT.
eat → ate → EATEN (V3).

'ever' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.

tasks.prompt: 4b  B: Yes, I ............................. (eat) Chinese food last month.
tasks.promptUz: Ha, o'tgan oyda xitoy taomini yedim.
tasks.whyUz:
'LAST MONTH' — ANIQ VAQT → PAST SIMPLE.
eat → ATE (V2).

DIQQAT: savolda 'EATEN' (V3),
javobda 'ATE' (V2) — adashtirmang!
tasks.speak: 4b  B: Yes, I ............................. (eat) Chinese food last month.

tasks.whyUz:
O'sha safar haqida → PAST SIMPLE.
'DID you LIKE?' ('liked' EMAS).

'like' — his fe'li, Continuous bo'lmaydi.

PAST SIMPLE. taste → TASTED (to'g'ri fe'l).

⚠ 'taste + SIFAT':
  'It tasted TERRIBLE.'  ✓
  'It tasted terriblY.'  ✗

His fe'llaridan keyin SIFAT (look, smell,
taste, sound, feel).

KALIT: 'EVER' → PRESENT PERFECT.
work → WORKED (to'g'ri fe'l).

'work IN a bar' — predlog 'in'.

'LAST SUMMER' — ANIQ VAQT → PAST SIMPLE.

DIQQAT: to'g'ri fe'lda V2 = V3 ('worked'),
shuning uchun shakli bir xil ko'rinadi —
lekin ZAMONI boshqa!

O'sha safar haqida → PAST SIMPLE.
'DID you ENJOY?' ('enjoyed' EMAS).

'to enjoy' — o'timli fe'l, to'ldiruvchi SHART
('enjoy IT').

PAST SIMPLE. enjoy → ENJOYED.

'very much' — gap oxirida.
'I enjoyed it very much' ✓
'I very much enjoyed it' ✓ (rasmiyroq)

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda namunalardagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAKKIZ KO'RSATMA, HAR BIRIDA (Yes) yoki (No).

KITOBDA IKKI NAMUNA BERILGAN (1 va 2).


IKKI QOLIP:

  (Yes) bo'lsa:
     A: Has/Have ... [V3] ... YET?
     B: Yes, ... has/have ALREADY [V3] ...

  (No) bo'lsa:
     A: Has/Have ... [V3] ... YET?
     B: No, ... hasn't/haven't [V3] ... YET.


BARCHA SAKKIZ DIALOG:

 1  (they/visit/San Diego) - (Yes)
    A: Have they visited San Diego YET?
    B: Yes, they have ALREADY visited San
       Diego.
       (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  (she/have/breakfast) - (No)
    A: Has she had breakfast YET?
    B: No, she hasn't had breakfast YET.
       (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 3  (Bill/do/the shopping) - (No)
    A: Has Bill done the shopping YET?
    B: No, he hasn't done the shopping YET.

 4  (Laura/finish/her homework) - (Yes)
    A: Has Laura finished her homework YET?
    B: Yes, she has ALREADY finished her
       homework.

 5  (they/buy/their tickets) - (Yes)
    A: Have they bought their tickets YET?
    B: Yes, they have ALREADY bought their
       tickets.

 6  (Bill/do/the ironing) - (No)
    A: Has Bill done the ironing YET?
    B: No, he hasn't done the ironing YET.

 7  (Mike/visit/the Louvre) - (Yes)
    A: Has Mike visited the Louvre YET?
    B: Yes, he has ALREADY visited the Louvre.

 8  (you/tidy/your room) - (No)
    A: Have you tidied your room YET?
    B: No, I haven't tidied my room YET.


⚠ UCh MUHIM NUQTA:

 1) HAS yoki HAVE?
    Bill, Laura, Mike, she  →  HAS
    they, you               →  HAVE

 2) JAVOBDA EGA OLMOSHGA AYLANADI:
    'Bill' → 'HE'
    'Laura' → 'SHE'
    'Mike' → 'HE'
    'they' → 'THEY'

 3) 8-BANDDA EGALIK OLMOShI O'ZGARADI:
    Savol:  'Have YOU tidied YOUR room?'
    Javob:  'No, I haven't tidied MY room.'

    'your' → 'MY' (chunki javob beruvchi
    o'zi haqida gapiryapti).

    Bu — eng ko'p unutiladigan joy!


V3 ShAKLLARI:
  visit  →  VISITED   (to'g'ri)
  have   →  HAD       (V2 = V3)
  do     →  DONE
  finish →  FINISHED  (to'g'ri)
  buy    →  BOUGHT    (V2 = V3)
  tidy   →  TIDIED    (y → i + ed)


DIQQAT — 'TIDIED':
  tidy → TIDIED (undoshdan keyingi 'Y' →
  I + ED).
  Grammar 64-bet: 'bury → buried' bilan bir
  xil qoida.


DIQQAT — 'HAVE BREAKFAST':
  'to HAVE breakfast/lunch/dinner' = yemoq
  Present Perfect da: 'has HAD breakfast'

  Ikki marta 'have' — biri yordamchi, biri
  asosiy fe'l:
     'she HAS HAD breakfast'
      ↑yordamchi ↑asosiy (V3)


UY IShLARI (3, 6-bandlar):
  do the shopping = xarid qilmoq
  do the ironing  = dazmollamoq


RASM:
  Ko'rfazdagi qayiqlar va orqada osmono'par
  binolar — SAN DIEGO (1-band).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  San Diego = San-Diyego (AQSh, Kaliforniya)
  breakfast = nonushta
  a ticket  = chipta
  the ironing = dazmollash
  the Louvre = Luvr muzeyi
  to tidy   = yig'ishtirmoq, tartibga solmoq

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in since or for, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: since yoki for ni qo'ying, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  FOR   nine years    (NAMUNA)
   2  SINCE Monday
   3  SINCE 1971
   4  FOR   a day
   5  SINCE last month
   6  FOR   six weeks
   7  FOR   a weekend
   8  SINCE December
   9  FOR   five days
  10  SINCE yesterday
  11  SINCE last night
  12  FOR   a week

  Ya'ni: FOR — 1, 4, 6, 7, 9, 12 (6 ta)
         SINCE — 2, 3, 5, 8, 10, 11 (6 ta)

  Oltitadan TENG!


OLTIN QOIDA:

  FOR   +  QANChA VAQT (davomiylik)
     nine years, a day, six weeks,
     a weekend, five days, a week

  SINCE +  QAChONDAN BERI (nuqta)
     Monday, 1971, last month, December,
     yesterday, last night


QANDAY AJRATISh — IKKI BELGI:

  A) 'A' yoki RAQAM bilan boshlansa → FOR
        FOR nine years
        FOR A day
        FOR six weeks
        FOR A weekend
        FOR five days
        FOR A week

  B) KUN, OY, YIL nomi yoki 'LAST',
     'YESTERDAY' → SINCE
        SINCE Monday      (kun nomi)
        SINCE 1971        (yil)
        SINCE December    (oy nomi)
        SINCE LAST month
        SINCE YESTERDAY
        SINCE LAST night


⚠ ENG NOZIK JUFTLIKLAR:

   4  FOR a day       ↔  10  SINCE yesterday
      (bir kun davomida)  (kechadan beri)

   7  FOR a weekend   ↔   2  SINCE Monday
      (bir dam olish       (dushanbadan beri)
       kuni davomida)

  12  FOR a week      ↔   5  SINCE last month
      (bir hafta          (o'tgan oydan beri)
       davomida)

  Farqi: 'A' bilan boshlansa MIQDOR;
  aniq nom bo'lsa NUQTA.


DIQQAT — 11-BAND, 'LAST NIGHT':
  'SINCE last night' = o'tgan kechadan beri

  DIQQAT: 'last night' — Past Simple
  ko'rsatkichi ham bo'lishi mumkin
  ('I went there LAST NIGHT'), lekin
  'since' bilan kelsa — Present Perfect.

  Farqi:
     'I saw him LAST NIGHT.'      (Past Simple)
     'I haven't seen him SINCE LAST NIGHT.'
                                  (Pres. Perf.)


DIQQAT — 10-BAND, 'YESTERDAY':
  'SINCE yesterday' = kechadan beri ✓
  'FOR yesterday' — XATO (ma'nosiz)

  Lekin 'yesterday' o'zi (since siz) —
  Past Simple ko'rsatkichi:
     'I saw him YESTERDAY.'


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR:

  FOR:
     for two hours, for ten minutes,
     for a month, for ages, for a long time,
     for ever

  SINCE:
     since 2010, since April, since Christmas,
     since I was a child, since he left,
     since this morning


DIQQAT — 'SINCE' + GAP:
  'since' dan keyin TO'LIQ GAP ham keladi:
     'since I was a child'
     'since he left'
  Bunda gap PAST SIMPLE da bo'ladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a weekend = dam olish kunlari
  December  = dekabr
  a week    = hafta

tasks.prompt: 1  ............ nine years
tasks.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
'nine years' — RAQAM + VAQT BIRLIGI
→ DAVOMIYLIK → FOR.

'Monday' — HAFTA KUNI nomi, ANIQ NUQTA
→ SINCE.
'1971' — YIL, ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE.

'a day' — 'A' bilan boshlanadi, ya'ni MIQDOR
→ FOR.

⚠ 10-BAND BILAN SOLISHTIRING:
  FOR a day       (bir kun davomida)
  SINCE yesterday (kechadan beri)

tasks.prompt: 5  ............ last month
tasks.whyUz:
'last month' — 'LAST' so'zi ANIQ NUQTANI
bildiradi → SINCE.

Solishtiring: 'FOR a month' (bir oy davomida).
'six weeks' — RAQAM + VAQT BIRLIGI → FOR.

'a weekend' — 'A' bilan, MIQDOR → FOR.

'a weekend' = shanba-yakshanba.

'December' — OY nomi, ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE.

Oy nomlari BOSH HARF bilan yoziladi.
'five days' — RAQAM + VAQT BIRLIGI → FOR.

'yesterday' — ANIQ NUQTA (kecha) → SINCE.

'FOR yesterday' — ma'nosiz.

DIQQAT: 'yesterday' o'zi (since siz) —
Past Simple ko'rsatkichi:
'I saw him YESTERDAY.'

'last night' — 'LAST' bilan, ANIQ NUQTA
→ SINCE.

DIQQAT — IKKI XIL ISHLATILISH:
  'I saw him LAST NIGHT.' (Past Simple)
  'I haven't seen him SINCE LAST NIGHT.'
     (Present Perfect)

'a week' — 'A' bilan, MIQDOR → FOR.

Solishtiring: 'SINCE last week'
(o'tgan haftadan beri).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in yet, how long, never, since, just, for or ever, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: yet, how long, never, since, just, for yoki ever ni qo'ying, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  HOW LONG have you lived in Turkey?
    (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)
 2  Sophie has NEVER been to the opera before.
 3  I've JUST finished my homework.
 4  He has been working in Hungary SINCE 1993.
 5  No, I haven't paid it YET.
 6  HOW LONG have you worked here?
 7  Yes, I have JUST cleaned it.
 8  I have NEVER been fishing before.
 9  Have you EVER been on a canoe trip?


⚠ DIQQAT — RO'YXAT BILAN BO'ShLIQ SONI
MOS KELMAYDI:

  Ro'yxatda 7 so'z: yet, how long, never,
  since, just, for, ever
  Bo'shliqlar: 9 ta

  Demak ba'zi so'zlar IKKI marta ishlatiladi:
     HOW LONG — 1 va 6-bandlar
     NEVER    — 2 va 8-bandlar
     JUST     — 3 va 7-bandlar

  Va 'FOR' UMUMAN ishlatilmaydi —
  kitob ro'yxatga ortiqcha so'z qo'shgan.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  '... have you lived in Turkey?'
    Savol MUDDAT haqida → HOW LONG.
    (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  'Sophie has ... been to the opera BEFORE.'
    KALIT: 'BEFORE' (ilgari) — tajriba haqida.
    TASDIQ shakl, INKOR ma'no → NEVER.

 3  'I've ... finished my homework.'
    TASDIQ gap, harakat yaqinda tugagan
    → JUST.
    ('yet' tasdiqda ishlatilmaydi;
     'ever' oddiy tasdiqda ishlatilmaydi.)

 4  'He has been working in Hungary ... 1993.'
    '1993' — YIL, ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE.

 5  'No, I HAVEN'T paid it ...'

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the table with the past simple and the past participle of the irregular verbs.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalni noto'g'ri fe'llarning past simple va past participle shakllari bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   INFINITIVE  PAST SIMPLE  PAST PARTICIPLE
   (V1)        (V2)         (V3)
   ──────────  ───────────  ───────────────
 1  buy         BOUGHT       BOUGHT
 2  eat         ATE          EATEN
 3  do          DID          DONE
 4  see         SAW          SEEN
 5  make        MADE         MADE
 6  take        TOOK         TAKEN
 7  give        GAVE         GIVEN
 8  ride        RODE         RIDDEN
 9  leave       LEFT         LEFT
10  meet        MET          MET


IKKI GURUHGA BO'LINADI:

  A) V2 = V3 (bir xil) — 4 ta:
       buy   → bought → BOUGHT
       make  → made   → MADE
       leave → left   → LEFT
       meet  → met    → MET

  B) V2 ≠ V3 (boshqa) — 6 ta:
       eat   → ate   → EATEN
       do    → did   → DONE
       see   → saw   → SEEN
       take  → took  → TAKEN
       give  → gave  → GIVEN
       ride  → rode  → RIDDEN

  DIQQAT: B guruhning HAMMASI '-EN' yoki
  '-NE' bilan tugaydi:
     eaten, done, seen, taken, given, ridden


QAYERDA IShLATILADI:

  V2 (Past Simple):
     'I BOUGHT some souvenirs.'
     'I SAW them yesterday.'
     'I RODE a camel.'

  V3 (Present Perfect):
     'I have BOUGHT some souvenirs.'
     'I have SEEN them.'
     'I have RIDDEN a camel.'


HAR BIRI COURSEBOOK'DA UChRAGAN:

  buy   →  105-bet: 'I BOUGHT some souvenirs'
  eat   →  106-bet: 'Have you ever EATEN
           Chinese food?'
  do    →  105-bet: 'things I haven't DONE
           yet'
  see   →  105-bet: 'I have also SEEN the
           Pyramids'
  make  →  108-bet: 'they can MAKE your visit
           a nightmare'
  take  →  105-bet: 'Abdullah TOOK me there'
  give  →  100-bet: 'GIVE it with both hands'
  ride  →  105-bet: 'I even RODE a camel'
  leave →  100-bet: 'LEAVE your shoes at the
           door'
  meet  →  106-bet: 'Have you ever MET a
           famous person?'


⚠ ENG KO'P ADAShTIRILADIGANLAR:

  eat:   ATE (V2) ≠ EATEN (V3)
     'I ATE it yesterday.'      ✓
     'I have EATEN it.'         ✓
     'I have ATE it.'           ✗

  see:   SAW (V2) ≠ SEEN (V3)
     'I SAW him.'               ✓
     'I have SEEN him.'         ✓
     'I have SAW him.'          ✗

  ride:  RODE (V2) ≠ RIDDEN (V3)
     'I RODE a camel.'          ✓
     'I have RIDDEN a camel.'   ✓


DIQQAT — 'LEAVE' IKKI MA'NOLI:
  'to leave' = ketmoq; qoldirmoq
     'The boat has LEFT.' (ketdi)
     'LEAVE your shoes at the door.'
       (qoldiring)

  V2 = V3 = LEFT.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the infinitive = fe'lning boshlang'ich shakli
  past simple    = o'tgan zamon (V2)
  past participle = III shakl (V3)

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with been or gone.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni been yoki gone bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
QOIDA (betdagi qutidan):

  'Mark HAS GONE to Spain.'
     (He went to Spain some time ago and he
      is STILL THERE.)

  'I HAVE BEEN to Spain.'
     (I have visited Spain and COME BACK.
      I am NOT there now.)


ENG ODDIY FARQ:
  GONE  →  ketgan va HALI U YERDA (odam YO'Q)
  BEEN  →  borib QAYTGAN (odam BOR)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  BEEN
  2  GONE
  3  BEEN
  4  GONE
  5  BEEN


HAR BIRI NEGA — KALIT GAPGA QARANG:

 1  'I have ... to the USA. I WENT THERE LAST
     SUMMER.'
    KALIT: 'I went there LAST SUMMER' — demak
    borib QAYTGAN (hozir AQShda emas).
    → BEEN

 2  'GEORGE ISN'T IN GREECE. He has ... to
     Italy.'
    KALIT: 'George ISN'T in Greece' — u
    boshqa joyda, ya'ni ITALIYADA.
    → GONE (hali u yerda)

 3  'HAVE YOU EVER ... to Bali?'
    KALIT: 'EVER' — TAJRIBA haqida savol.
    Tajriba = borib qaytish.
    → BEEN

 4  'My parents have ... to Portugal.
     THEY'LL BE BACK NEXT WEEK.'
    KALIT: 'They'll be BACK next week' —
    demak HOZIR Portugaliyada.
    → GONE

 5  'I have NEVER ... to Egypt, BUT I WANT TO
     GO one day.'
    KALIT: 'I want to GO one day' — hali
    bormagan, tajriba yo'q.
    → BEEN
    ('I have never GONE' — ishlatilmaydi)


⚠ ENG ODDIY BELGI — KEYINGI GAP:

  'I WENT there last summer.'  → BEEN (1)
  'He ISN'T in Greece.'        → GONE (2)
  'They'll be BACK next week.' → GONE (4)
  'I want to GO one day.'      → BEEN (5)

  Ya'ni har bandda YONIDAGI gap javobni
  aytib turibdi!


⚠ MUHIM QOIDA — 'I HAVE GONE' DEYARLI
IShLATILMAYDI:

  Agar o'zingiz haqingizda gapirsangiz,
  DOIM 'BEEN':
     'I have BEEN to the USA.'   ✓
     'I have GONE to the USA.'   ✗ (g'alati)

  Chunki agar AQShda bo'lsangiz, bu gapni
  ayta olmaysiz!

  'GONE' faqat BOShQA odam haqida:
     'He has GONE to Italy.'
     'My parents have GONE to Portugal.'

  Mashqda ham shunday:
     BEEN — 1, 3, 5 (I / you)
     GONE — 2, 4 (George / my parents)


BOG'LIQLIK — COURSEBOOK:
  104-bet: 'Have you ever BEEN there?'
  106-bet: 'I've BEEN to Spain.'
           'I've never BEEN to China.'
  107-bet: 'Have you BEEN to Palacio Real
            yet?'

  Coursebook'da deyarli doim 'been' —
  chunki hammasi TAJRIBA haqida.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Greece   = Gretsiya
  Italy    = Italiya
  Bali     = Bali (Indoneziya oroli)
  Portugal = Portugaliya
  to be back = qaytmoq

IKKI JADVAL, HAR BIRIDA IKKI USTUN:

⚠ AUDIO ShART EMAS — YOZILIShI TOVUShNI
BELGILAYDI:

  'SH' harflari      →  /ʃ/
     shoes, wash, wish, sheet

  'CH' yoki 'TCH'    →  /tʃ/

IKKI TOVUSh QANDAY ChIQARILADI:

         'wash'  = 'vosh'
         Havo uzluksiz chiqadi.

  /tʃ/ — 'Ch' tovushi (o'zbekcha 'ch' bilan
         bir xil)

         'watch'  = 'voch'
         Til birdan uzilib, 'portlash' bo'ladi.

  FARQI: /tʃ/ — /t/ + /ʃ/ birikmasi,
  shuning uchun boshida QISQA to'siq bor.


JUFTLIKLAR — ATAYLAB TANLANGAN:

  Kitob so'zlarni JUFT qilib bergan —
  faqat bir tovush bilan farq qiladi:

     shoes  /ʃuːz/    ↔  choose /tʃuːz/
     wash   /wɒʃ/     ↔  watch  /wɒtʃ/
     wish   /wɪʃ/     ↔  witch  /wɪtʃ/
     sheet  /ʃiːt/    ↔  cheat  /tʃiːt/

  Bunday juftliklar 'minimal juftlik'
  deyiladi — faqat BITTA tovush farq qiladi.

  Agar tovushni noto'g'ri aytsangiz,
  BOShQA so'z chiqadi!

  watch  = soat; tomosha qilmoq
  wish   = tilak; xohlamoq

  Uzun unli yoki undoshdan keyin faqat 'ch':

  /ʃ/ (sh):

     (*'sure' — 's' bilan yozilsa ham /ʃ/)

  /tʃ/ (ch):
