exercises.explanationUz:
JADVALNING TO'RT USTUNI:
  HAS  |  WHEN  |  WHAT IT WAS LIKE  |
  WHAT HE DID THERE

Kitob BIRINCHI qatorni to'ldirib bergan
(namuna).


TO'LIQ JADVAL:

 ┌────────────────┬──────────┬─────────────┬──────────────┐
 │ HAS            │ WHEN     │ WHAT IT WAS │ WHAT HE DID  │
 │                │          │ LIKE        │ THERE        │
 ├────────────────┼──────────┼─────────────┼──────────────┤
 │ visited the    │ Tuesday  │ noisy &     │ bought       │
 │ Khan al-Khalili│          │ crowded     │ souvenirs    │
 │ bazaar         │          │             │  (NAMUNA)    │
 ├────────────────┼──────────┼─────────────┼──────────────┤
 │ seen the       │ yesterday│ amazing     │ rode a camel │
 │ Pyramids and   │          │             │              │
 │ the Sphinx     │          │             │              │
 ├────────────────┼──────────┼─────────────┼──────────────┤
 │ been to a      │ last     │ fantastic   │ tried        │
 │ traditional    │ night    │ (food was   │ couscous and │
 │ restaurant     │          │ delicious)  │ falafel      │
 └────────────────┴──────────┴─────────────┴──────────────┘


HAR USTUN QAYERDAN OLINADI:

  HAS  →  Present Perfect gaplaridan
     'I've already VISITED the bazaar'
     'I have also SEEN the Pyramids'
     'I've BEEN TO a traditional restaurant'

  WHEN →  Past Simple gaplaridagi VAQTDAN
     'We visited it ON TUESDAY'
     'I saw them YESTERDAY'
     'Abdullah took me there LAST NIGHT'

  WHAT IT WAS LIKE →  SIFATLARDAN
     'how NOISY AND CROWDED it was'
     'They were AMAZING'
     'The place was FANTASTIC'

  WHAT HE DID THERE →  qo'shimcha
  harakatlardan
     'I BOUGHT some souvenirs'
     'I even RODE A CAMEL'
     'I TRIED couscous and falafel'


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA DIALOG:

  SA: HAS Jack VISITED the Khan al-Khalili
      bazaar?
  SB: Yes, he HAS.
  SA: WHEN DID he VISIT it?
  SB: On Tuesday.
  SA: What WAS it LIKE?
  SB: It WAS noisy and crowded.
  SA: What DID he DO there?
  SB: He BOUGHT some souvenirs.


⚠ ENG MUHIM GRAMMATIK DARS —
ZAMON ALMAShUVI:

  1-savol:  'HAS Jack VISITED ...?'
            → PRESENT PERFECT
            (vaqt aytilmagan)
  Javob:    'Yes, he HAS.'

  2-savol:  'WHEN DID he VISIT it?'
            → PAST SIMPLE
            ('when' — ANIQ vaqt so'ralyapti!)
  Javob:    'On Tuesday.'

  Ya'ni birinchi savol Present Perfect da,
  lekin 'WHEN' so'ralishi bilan zamon
  PAST SIMPLE ga o'tadi.

  BU — Unit 15 ning eng muhim qoidasi:
     'Has he visited?' ✓ (vaqt yo'q)
     'When HAS he visited?' ✗ XATO
     'When DID he VISIT?'  ✓


QOLGAN IKKI QATOR UChUN TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR:

  SA: Has Jack seen the Pyramids and the
      Sphinx?
  SB: Yes, he has.
  SA: When did he see them?
  SB: Yesterday.
  SA: What were they like?
  SB: They were amazing.
  SA: What did he do there?
  SB: He rode a camel.

  SA: Has Jack been to a traditional
      restaurant?
  SB: Yes, he has.
  SA: When did he go there?
  SB: Last night.
  SA: What was it like?
  SB: It was fantastic and the food was
      delicious.
  SA: What did he do there?
  SB: He tried couscous and falafel.


DIQQAT — 'WHAT WAS IT LIKE?' va
'WHAT WERE THEY LIKE?':
  Ega BIRLIK bo'lsa   →  'What WAS IT like?'
  Ega KO'PLIK bo'lsa  →  'What WERE THEY like?'

  Ehromlar va Sfenks — KO'PLIK, shuning uchun
  'What WERE THEY like?' va 'They WERE
  amazing.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  crowded    = gavjum
  amazing    = hayratlanarli
  fantastic  = ajoyib
  a souvenir = sovg'a, esdalik

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the three short dialogues and decide who is: a) making a reservation at a restaurant; b) inviting somebody out; c) buying souvenirs. In pairs, act out the dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Uchta qisqa dialogni tinglang va kim: a) restoranda joy band qilayotganini; b) birovni taklif qilayotganini; c) sovg'a sotib olayotganini aniqlang. Juftlikda dialoglarni sahnalashtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — AUDIO ShART EMAS:
  Uchala dialog ham betda TO'LIQ bosilgan.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1-dialog  →  b) inviting somebody out
               (birovni taklif qilish)
  2-dialog  →  c) buying souvenirs
               (sovg'a sotib olish)
  3-dialog  →  a) making a reservation at a
               restaurant
               (restoranda joy band qilish)


1-DIALOG (TO'LIQ) — b) TAKLIF QILISh:

  A: Hello, Rachel. What are you doing
     tonight?
  B: I haven't got any plans. Why?
  A: Well, there's a good film on at the Odeon
     tonight. Would you like to go?
  B: Yes — that would be great!
  A: Okay. I'll pick you up at eight, then.

  Tarjimasi:
  A: Salom, Reychel. Bugun kechqurun nima
     qilyapsan?
  B: Hech qanday rejam yo'q. Nima edi?
  A: Bugun kechqurun Odeonda yaxshi kino bor.
     Borishni xohlaysanmi?
  B: Ha — zo'r bo'lardi!
  A: Yaxshi. Unda sakkizda kelib olib
     ketaman.

  KALIT: 'WOULD YOU LIKE TO GO?' — taklif.


2-DIALOG (TO'LIQ) — c) SOVG'A SOTIB OLISh:

  A: Can I help you?
  B: Yes, please. I'm looking for a gift to
     take home for my brother.
  A: How about this wallet? It's a lovely gift
     for a man.
  B: How much is it?
  A: It's only £10.
  B: Great — I'll take it. I'm sure he'll like
     it.

  Tarjimasi:
  A: Yordam bera olamanmi?
  B: Ha, iltimos. Akamga olib ketish uchun
     sovg'a qidiryapman.
  A: Bu hamyon qanday? Erkak uchun ajoyib
     sovg'a.
  B: Qanchа turadi?
  A: Atigi 10 funt.
  B: Zo'r — olaman. Unga yoqishiga ishonchim
     komil.

  KALIT: 'I'm looking for a GIFT', 'How much
  is it?', 'I'LL TAKE IT' — do'kondagi savdo.


3-DIALOG (TO'LIQ) — a) JOY BAND QILISh:

  A: Hello. I'd like to book a table for
     tonight, please.
  B: Certainly, madam. What time and for how
     many?
  A: A table for two at nine o'clock, please.
  B: That's fine. Could I have your name,
     please?
  A: Powers. Ann Powers.
  B: Thank you, Ms Powers. We'll see you
     tonight.

  Tarjimasi:
  A: Salom. Bugun kechqurunga stol band
     qilmoqchi edim.
  B: Albatta, xonim. Soat nechada va necha
     kishiga?
  A: Soat to'qqizda ikki kishiga stol,
     iltimos.
  B: Yaxshi. Ismingizni ayta olasizmi?
  A: Pauers. Enn Pauers.
  B: Rahmat, Missis Pauers. Bugun kechqurun
     ko'rishguncha.

  KALIT: 'I'd like to BOOK A TABLE' —
  restoranda joy band qilish.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — HAR DIALOGDA BITTA
KALIT IBORA:

  1  'Would you like to go?'   →  TAKLIF (b)
  2  'I'm looking for a gift'  →  XARID (c)
  3  'I'd like to book a table' → BAND QILISh (a)


HAR VAZIYAT UChUN FOYDALI IBORALAR:

  TAKLIF QILISh (inviting somebody out):
     'What are you doing tonight?'
     'Would you like to go?'
     'Yes, that would be great!'
     'I'll pick you up at eight.'

     RAD ETISh:
     'I'd love to, but I can't.'
     'Sorry, I'm busy tonight.'

  XARID QILISh (buying souvenirs):
     'Can I help you?'
     'I'm looking for ...'
     'How about this ...?'
     'How much is it?'
     'I'll take it.'

  JOY BAND QILISh (making a reservation):
     'I'd like to book a table.'
     'What time and for how many?'
     'A table for two at nine o'clock.'
     'Could I have your name, please?'


DIQQAT — 'I'LL TAKE IT':
  'I'LL take it' = olaman (sotib olaman)
  Do'konda qaror qabul qilish shakli.
  WILL — ayni damdagi qaror (Unit 13).


DIQQAT — 'TO PICK SOMEBODY UP':
  'I'll PICK YOU UP at eight.'
  = sakkizda kelib olib ketaman (mashinada)

  Ajraladigan fe'l:
     pick you up  ✓
     pick up you  ✗ (olmosh bilan faqat
                     o'rtada)


DIQQAT — 'MS':
  'Thank you, MS Powers.'
  Ms /mɪz/ — ayolga murojaat, turmush
  qurgan-qurmaganini bildirmaydi.

     Mrs — turmush qurgan ayol
     Miss — turmush qurmagan ayol
     Ms — ikkalasiga ham (zamonaviy, odobli)


DIQQAT — 'CERTAINLY, MADAM':
  Xizmat sohasida odobli murojaat:
     'madam' — ayolga
     'sir' — erkakka


DIQQAT — 'COULD I HAVE ...?':
  'COULD I have your name, please?'
  'could' — 'can' dan ODOBLIROQ
  (Grammar 60-bet).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a reservation   = joy band qilish
  to book a table = stol band qilmoq
  to invite somebody out = birovni taklif
                    qilmoq
  plans           = rejalar
  the Odeon       = Odeon (kinoteatr nomi)
  to pick somebody up = kelib olib ketmoq
  a gift          = sovg'a
  a wallet        = hamyon (erkak)
  How much is it? = Qancha turadi?
  Certainly       = Albatta
  madam / sir     = xonim / janob
  Ms              = ayolga murojaat

exercises.instructionEn: You are going to listen to some short exchanges. Read the possible responses, then listen and choose the best answer. — the item that grammar alone decides
exercises.instructionUz: Qisqa savol-javoblarni tinglaysiz. Mumkin bo'lgan javoblarni o'qing, so'ngra tinglab eng to'g'ri javobni tanlang. — grammatikaning o'zi hal qiladigan band
exercises.explanationUz:
MAShQNING TUZILIShI:
  Kitobda SAVOLLAR bosilmagan — faqat
  ikkitadan JAVOB varianti berilgan.
  Savollar audioda aytiladi.

  Shuning uchun ko'p bandni faqat tinglab
  aniqlash mumkin.

  LEKIN 4-band ISTISNO: uning bir varianti
  GRAMMATIK JIHATDAN NOTO'G'RI, shuning
  uchun savolni bilmasdan ham javob aniq.


4-BAND:
  a) Yes, I loved it.   ✓
  b) Yes, I loved.      ✗ NOTO'G'RI!


NEGA b) NOTO'G'RI:

  'to LOVE' — O'TIMLI fe'l, ya'ni undan
  keyin TO'LDIRUVCHI kelishi SHART:

     'I love IT.'       ✓
     'I love MUSIC.'    ✓
     'I love YOU.'      ✓
     'I loved.'         ✗ (nimani?)

  Ingliz tilida ba'zi fe'llar to'ldiruvchisiz
  ishlatilmaydi.


SHU KABI O'TIMLI FE'LLAR:
  like, love, hate, want, need, enjoy,
  buy, take, make, put

  'I like.'      ✗   →  'I like it.'      ✓
  'I want.'      ✗   →  'I want it.'      ✓
  'I enjoyed.'   ✗   →  'I enjoyed it.'   ✓


O'TIMSIZ FE'LLAR (to'ldiruvchisiz ham
bo'ladi):
  go, come, sleep, arrive, laugh, cry

  'I slept.'     ✓
  'She arrived.' ✓


DEMAK 4-BAND UChUN AUDIO ShART EMAS:
  Savol qanday bo'lishidan qat'i nazar,
  'Yes, I loved.' — noto'g'ri ingliz tili.

  Javob: a) Yes, I loved it.

  (Savol, ehtimol: 'Did you like the film?'
   yoki 'What was the museum like?')


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an exchange = qisqa savol-javob
  a response  = javob
  possible    = mumkin bo'lgan

tasks.prompt: 4  a) Yes, I loved it.   b) Yes, I loved.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ AUDIO SHART EMAS — b) varianti GRAMMATIK
JIHATDAN NOTO'G'RI.

'to LOVE' — O'TIMLI fe'l, undan keyin
TO'LDIRUVCHI kelishi SHART:
  'I loved IT.'  ✓
  'I loved.'     ✗ (nimani?)

Shu kabi fe'llar: like, want, need, enjoy,
buy, take, make.

Savol qanday bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, javob
a) bo'ladi.

exercises.instructionUz: 19-mashq — audio kerak bo'lgan o'n bir band, har javob qaysi savolga mos kelishi tahlili bilan
exercises.explanationUz:
OChIQ QOLGAN 11 BAND

Kitobda savollar bosilmagani uchun bu
bandlarni faqat tinglab aniqlash mumkin.
TAXMIN BILAN TO'LDIRILMADI.

Lekin quyida har javob QAYSI SAVOLGA mos
kelishi tahlil qilingan — audioni
tinglaganda darhol tanlay olasiz.


 1  a) I'd love to.      b) I like it.

    a) — TAKLIFGA javob
       Savol: 'Would you like to come?' /
              'Shall we go out?'
       ('I'd love to' = juda xohlardim)
    b) — FIKR so'ralganda
       Savol: 'How do you like it?' /
              'What do you think of it?'

    KALIT: savol TAKLIFmi yoki FIKRmi?


 2  a) Two weeks ago.    b) Since Monday.

    a) — 'WHEN did you ...?' (Past Simple)
       'ago' → aniq o'tmish nuqtasi
    b) — 'HOW LONG have you ...?'
       (Present Perfect)
       'since' → boshlanish nuqtasi

    KALIT: savol 'WHEN did' mi yoki
           'HOW LONG have' mi?
    (107-betdagi for/since qoidasi!)


 3  a) Yes, I can.       b) Yes, please.

    a) — 'CAN you ...?' (qobiliyat/iltimos)
       Qisqa javob savoldagi modalni
       takrorlaydi.
    b) — TAKLIFGA rozilik
       Savol: 'Would you like some tea?' /
              'Can I help you?'

    KALIT: savol QOBILIYAT haqidami yoki
           TAKLIFmi?


 5  a) Yes, you have.    b) Yes, you do.

    a) — 'HAVE I ...?' savoliga
       ('Have I got time?')
    b) — 'DO I ...?' savoliga
       ('Do I have to pay?')

    KALIT: savol 'HAVE' bilanmi yoki 'DO'
           bilanmi boshlangan?


 6  a) You must.         b) Of course.

    a) — 'MUST I ...?' savoliga
       ('Must I go now?' → 'Yes, you must.')
    b) — RUXSAT so'ralganda
       ('Can I use your phone?' →
        'Of course.')

    KALIT: savol MAJBURIYAT haqidami yoki
           RUXSATmi?


 7  a) In the spring.    b) Cairo.

    a) — 'WHEN ...?' (vaqt)
    b) — 'WHERE ...?' (joy)

    KALIT: savol 'WHEN' mi yoki 'WHERE' mi?
    Eng oddiy band — faqat savol so'zini
    eshitish yetarli.


 8  a) Yes, I have.      b) Yes, I tried.

    a) — 'HAVE you ...?' savoliga
       ('Have you tried paella?')
       Qisqa javob 'have' ni takrorlaydi.
    b) — 'DID you ...?' savoliga
       (lekin standart javob 'Yes, I DID'
        bo'lardi)

    KALIT: savol 'HAVE you' mi yoki
           'DID you' mi?
    DIQQAT: a) — standart qisqa javob;
    b) shakli kamroq uchraydi.


 9  a) I won't.          b) That's a good idea.

    a) — OGOHLANTIRIShGA javob
       ('Don't be late!' → 'I won't.')
    b) — TAKLIFGA rozilik
       ('Why don't we go to the cinema?' →
        'That's a good idea.')

    KALIT: savol OGOHLANTIRIShmi yoki
           TAKLIFmi?


10  a) Sorry, you can't.  b) No, you shouldn't.

    a) — 'CAN I ...?' savoliga (ruxsat rad
       etiladi)
    b) — 'SHOULD I ...?' savoliga (maslahat)

    KALIT: savol 'CAN I' mi yoki 'SHOULD I' mi?
    (Qisqa javob savoldagi modalni
     takrorlaydi.)


11  a) Yes, you do.       b) Sorry, you mustn't.

    a) — 'DO I have to ...?' savoliga
       ('Do I have to pay?' → 'Yes, you do.')
    b) — 'CAN I ...?' yoki 'MAY I ...?'
       savoliga (taqiq)

    KALIT: savol MAJBURIYAT haqidami yoki
           RUXSAT so'rashmi?


12  a) Of course you can't. b) Of course you can.

    Ikkalasi ham 'CAN I ...?' savoliga javob,
    faqat biri RAD etadi, biri RUXSAT beradi.

    KALIT: bu bandni FAQAT audiodan aniqlash
    mumkin — savolning MAZMUNI hal qiladi
    (masalan, 'Can I borrow your pen?' →
     'Of course you can'; 'Can I smoke here?'
     → 'Of course you can't').


⚠ UMUMIY OLTIN QOIDA — QISQA JAVOB
SAVOLDAGI YORDAMChI/MODAL FE'LNI TAKRORLAYDI:

     'HAVE you ...?'      →  'Yes, I HAVE.'
     'DO you ...?'        →  'Yes, I DO.'
     'CAN I ...?'         →  'Yes, you CAN.'
     'MUST I ...?'        →  'Yes, you MUST.'
     'SHOULD I ...?'      →  'No, you
                              SHOULDN'T.'
     'DID you ...?'       →  'Yes, I DID.'

  Bu qoida 5, 8, 10, 11-bandlarni hal qiladi —
  faqat savolning BIRINChI SO'ZINI eshitish
  yetarli!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  I'd love to      = juda xohlardim
  Of course        = albatta
  That's a good idea = yaxshi fikr
  Sorry, you can't = kechirasiz, bo'lmaydi

tasks.en: 1  a) I'd love to. — answers an invitation.   b) I like it. — answers 'How do you like it?'
tasks.uz: 1  a) Juda xohlardim — TAKLIFGA javob.  b) Menga yoqadi — FIKR so'ralganda.
tasks.note:
KALIT: savol TAKLIFmi yoki FIKRmi?
AUDIODAN aniqlanadi.

tasks.en: 2  a) Two weeks ago. — answers 'When did you ...?'   b) Since Monday. — answers 'How long have you ...?'
tasks.uz: 2  a) Ikki hafta oldin — 'Qachon ...dingiz?'  b) Dushanbadan beri — 'Qancha vaqtdan beri ...?'
tasks.note:
KALIT: 'ago' → Past Simple savoli;
'since' → Present Perfect savoli.
107-betdagi for/since qoidasi.
AUDIODAN aniqlanadi.

tasks.en: 3  a) Yes, I can. — answers 'Can you ...?'   b) Yes, please. — accepts an offer.
tasks.uz: 3  a) Ha, qila olaman — 'Qila olasizmi?'  b) Ha, iltimos — TAKLIFGA rozilik.
tasks.note:
KALIT: savol QOBILIYAT haqidami yoki
TAKLIFmi?
AUDIODAN aniqlanadi.

tasks.en: 5  a) Yes, you have. — answers 'Have I ...?'   b) Yes, you do. — answers 'Do I ...?'
tasks.uz: 5  a) Ha, bor — 'Menda ... bormi?'  b) Ha — 'Men ... qilishim kerakmi?'
tasks.note:
QISQA JAVOB savoldagi yordamchi fe'lni
TAKRORLAYDI — savolning BIRINCHI so'zini
eshitish yetarli.
AUDIODAN aniqlanadi.

tasks.en: 6  a) You must. — answers 'Must I ...?'   b) Of course. — gives permission.
tasks.uz: 6  a) Kerak — 'Men ... qilishim shartmi?'  b) Albatta — RUXSAT berish.
tasks.note:
KALIT: savol MAJBURIYAT haqidami yoki
RUXSATmi?
AUDIODAN aniqlanadi.

tasks.en: 7  a) In the spring. — answers 'When ...?'   b) Cairo. — answers 'Where ...?'
tasks.uz: 7  a) Bahorda — 'Qachon ...?'  b) Qohira — 'Qayerda ...?'
tasks.note:
ENG ODDIY BAND: faqat savol so'zini
('when' yoki 'where') eshitish yetarli.
AUDIODAN aniqlanadi.

tasks.en: 8  a) Yes, I have. — answers 'Have you ...?'   b) Yes, I tried. — answers 'Did you ...?'
tasks.uz: 8  a) Ha, qildim — 'Siz ...ganmisiz?'  b) Ha, yeb ko'rdim — 'Siz ...dingizmi?'
tasks.note:
a) — STANDART qisqa javob ('Have you ...?'
ga).
b) shakli kamroq uchraydi (odatda
'Yes, I DID' deyiladi).
AUDIODAN aniqlanadi.

tasks.en: 9  a) I won't. — answers a warning ('Don't be late!').   b) That's a good idea. — accepts a suggestion.
tasks.uz: 9  a) Qilmayman — OGOHLANTIRISHGA javob.  b) Yaxshi fikr — TAKLIFGA rozilik.
tasks.note:
KALIT: savol OGOHLANTIRISHmi yoki TAKLIFmi?
AUDIODAN aniqlanadi.

tasks.en: 10  a) Sorry, you can't. — answers 'Can I ...?'   b) No, you shouldn't. — answers 'Should I ...?'
tasks.uz: 10  a) Kechirasiz, bo'lmaydi — 'Men ...sam bo'ladimi?'  b) Yo'q, kerak emas — 'Men ...ishim kerakmi?'
tasks.note:
Qisqa javob savoldagi MODALNI takrorlaydi:
'CAN I?' → 'you CAN'T';
'SHOULD I?' → 'you SHOULDN'T'.
AUDIODAN aniqlanadi.

tasks.en: 11  a) Yes, you do. — answers 'Do I have to ...?'   b) Sorry, you mustn't. — answers 'Can I ...?' (prohibition)
tasks.uz: 11  a) Ha, shart — 'Men ...ishim shartmi?'  b) Kechirasiz, mumkin emas — TAQIQ.
tasks.note:
KALIT: savol MAJBURIYAT haqidami yoki
RUXSAT so'rashmi?
AUDIODAN aniqlanadi.

tasks.en: 12  a) Of course you can't.   b) Of course you can.  — both answer 'Can I ...?'; only the meaning of the question decides.
tasks.uz: 12  a) Albatta, bo'lmaydi.  b) Albatta, bo'ladi. — ikkalasi ham 'Can I ...?' ga javob; faqat savolning MAZMUNI hal qiladi.
tasks.note:
Bu bandni FAQAT audiodan aniqlash mumkin —
grammatika yordam bermaydi, savolning
MAZMUNI kerak.

Masalan: 'Can I borrow your pen?' → b);
'Can I smoke here?' → a).

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information from Ex. 16 to write the letter Paul wrote to a friend while he was in Madrid.
exercises.instructionUz: 16-mashqdagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib, Pol Madridda ekanida do'stiga yozgan xatni yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
MANBA: 107-betdagi 16-mashq dialogi.

POL HAQIDA MA'LUM BO'LGAN NARSALAR:
  • Madridda
  • o'tgan dushanbadan beri shu yerda
  • do'sti Karlos bilan turadi
  • Prado muzeyiga borgan (o'tgan dushanba),
    u yerda go'zal kartinalar ko'rgan
  • Palacio Real'ga borgan (kecha),
    marosim xonalari ulug'vor edi
  • hali xarid qilgani bormagan
  • Rastro bozoriga borishni rejalashtirgan
  • paelya yeb ko'rgan ('Lhardy'
    restoranida, o'tgan kecha)
  • bugun kechqurun Carmen operasiga boradi


TO'LIQ NAMUNA XAT:

  ─────────────────────────────────────────
  Dear Tom,

  Greetings from Madrid! I'm having a
  wonderful time here. I'm staying with my
  friend Carlos and I've been here since last
  Monday.

  I've already visited a lot of places. I've
  been to the Prado Museum — I went there last
  Monday and I saw some beautiful paintings.
  I've also been to Palacio Real. I went there
  yesterday and the state rooms were
  magnificent. Last night I went to a
  restaurant called 'Lhardy' with some friends
  and I tried paella. The food was just
  delicious!

  I haven't been shopping yet, but I'm going
  to go to the Rastro flea market soon to buy
  some souvenirs. Tonight I'm going to the
  opera to see Carmen.

  Madrid is a fascinating city — you must
  visit it one day!

                            Best wishes,
                            Paul
  ─────────────────────────────────────────


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  Hurmatli Tom,

  Madriddan salom! Bu yerda ajoyib vaqt
  o'tkazyapman. Do'stim Karlos bilan turibman
  va o'tgan dushanbadan beri shu yerdaman.

  Allaqachon ko'p joylarga bordim. Prado
  muzeyiga borganman — u yerga o'tgan dushanba
  kuni bordim va bir necha go'zal kartina
  ko'rdim. Palacio Real'ga ham borganman.
  U yerga kecha bordim, marosim xonalari
  ulug'vor edi. O'tgan kecha do'stlarim bilan
  'Lhardy' restoraniga borib, paelya yeb
  ko'rdim. Ovqat juda mazali edi!

  Hali xarid qilgani bormadim, lekin tez orada
  sovg'a olish uchun Rastro bozoriga boraman.
  Bugun kechqurun Carmen operasiga boraman.

  Madrid — maftunkor shahar, bir kun kelib
  albatta borishing kerak!

                    Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
                    Pol
  ─────────────────────────────────────────


⚠ XATNING TUZILIShI — 105-BETDAGI JEKNING
XATI BILAN BIR XIL:

  1-xatboshi:  SALOM + qayerdaligi + kim
               bilan + qachondan beri
               (Present Perfect: 'I've been
                here SINCE ...')

  2-xatboshi:  QILGAN ishlar
               (Present Perfect → Past Simple
                naqshi)

  3-xatboshi:  QILMAGAN ishlar + REJALAR
               ('haven't ... YET' + 'going to')

  4-xatboshi:  BAHO + tavsiya
               ('a fascinating city —
                you must visit it')

  Yakun:       Best wishes, [ism]


⚠ ENG MUHIM NAQSh — HAR ISh IKKI ZAMONDA:

  'I've BEEN to the Prado Museum.'
     (Present Perfect — umumiy xabar)
  'I WENT there LAST MONDAY.'
     (Past Simple — aniq vaqt)

  'I've also BEEN to Palacio Real.'
  'I WENT there YESTERDAY.'

  Bu — Unit 15 ning oltin qoidasi.


KERAKLI IBORALAR:

  SALOM:
     'Greetings from [shahar]!'
     'I'm having a wonderful time.'

  QANChA VAQT:
     'I've been here SINCE last Monday.'
     'I've been here FOR a week.'

  QILGAN:
     'I've ALREADY visited ...'
     'I've also BEEN to ...'

  QILMAGAN:
     'I haven't ... YET.'

  REJA:
     'I'm GOING TO ...'
     'Tonight I'M GOING to ...'

  YAKUN:
     '... is a fascinating city —
      you must visit it one day!'
     'Best wishes,'


DIQQAT — 'A RESTAURANT CALLED 'LHARDY'':
  'a restaurant CALLED Lhardy' = 'Lhardy'
  deb ataladigan restoran

  'called' — nom berish uchun.


DIQQAT — XATDA OLMOSh:
  Dialogda Pol 'I' deb gapiradi, xat ham
  Poldan yozilgani uchun 'I' saqlanadi.

  (105-betdagi 4b-mashqda esa savolga javob
   berilgani uchun 'he' ga o'zgargan edi.)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a project    = loyiha
  while        = ... paytda
  called       = ... deb ataladigan

tasks.note:
3-XATBOSHI: QILMAGAN + REJA.

tasks.note:

tasks.uz: Madrid — maftunkor shahar, bir kun kelib albatta borishing kerak! Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan, Pol

sections.title: Writing (a friendly letter from a holiday destination)

exercises.instructionEn: When we are on holiday and we want to write to a friend to report our experiences, we start by saying where we are, when we arrived there, what the weather is like, and where we are staying. Then, we talk about the things we have or haven't done (present perfect), when we did them and what each was like (past simple). We also say what we are going to do. We end the letter by saying what we think of the place and when we are leaving.
exercises.instructionUz: Ta'tilda bo'lganimizda do'stimizga tajribalarimiz haqida yozmoqchi bo'lsak, qayerdaligimiz, u yerga qachon kelganimiz, havo qandayligi va qayerda turganimizni aytishdan boshlaymiz. So'ngra qilgan yoki qilmagan ishlarimiz (present perfect), ularni qachon qilganimiz va har biri qanday bo'lgani (past simple) haqida gapiramiz. Yana nima qilmoqchi ekanimizni ham aytamiz. Xatni joy haqidagi fikrimiz va qachon ketishimiz bilan tugatamiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
YOZISh QUTISI — XATNING TUZILIShI

KITOBDAGI QOIDA UCh QISMDAN IBORAT:


1) BOShLANISh (start) — TO'RT narsa:
     • WHERE WE ARE       (qayerdamiz)
     • WHEN WE ARRIVED    (qachon keldik)
     • WHAT THE WEATHER IS LIKE
                          (havo qanday)
     • WHERE WE ARE STAYING
                          (qayerda turibmiz)

2) ASOSIY QISM (then):
     • THINGS WE HAVE / HAVEN'T DONE
       →  PRESENT PERFECT
     • WHEN WE DID THEM
       →  PAST SIMPLE
     • WHAT EACH WAS LIKE
       →  PAST SIMPLE
     • WHAT WE ARE GOING TO DO
       →  BE GOING TO

3) YAKUN (end):
     • WHAT WE THINK OF THE PLACE
       (joy haqida fikrimiz)
     • WHEN WE ARE LEAVING
       (qachon ketamiz)


⚠ ENG MUHIM — ZAMONLAR TAQSIMOTI:

  QILGAN/QILMAGAN ishlar  →  PRESENT PERFECT
     'I've already visited ...'
     'I haven't been ... yet.'

  QAChON qilgan            →  PAST SIMPLE
     'I went there on Tuesday.'

  QANDAY bo'lgan           →  PAST SIMPLE
     'It was fantastic.'

  REJA                     →  BE GOING TO
     'We are going to visit the museum.'

  Bu — 105-betdagi Jekning xatining aynan
  tuzilishi!


MODEL: 105-BETDAGI JEKNING XATI

  Kitob aytadi: 'Use the letter in Ex. 4 as
  a model.'

  Jekning xatini qayta ko'rib chiqing —
  u bu qoidaning har bandini bajaradi:

     'Greetings from CAIRO!'          (qayerda)
     'I've been here SINCE MONDAY'    (qachon)
     'The weather is VERY HOT'        (havo)
     'I'm STAYING WITH my friend'     (qayerda
                                       turadi)
     'I've ALREADY VISITED ...'       (qilgan)
     'We VISITED it ON TUESDAY'       (qachon)
     'how NOISY AND CROWDED it WAS'   (qanday)
     'I HAVEN'T BEEN ... YET'         (qilmagan)
     'We ARE GOING TO VISIT ...'      (reja)
     'Cairo is a FASCINATING city'    (fikri)
     'I'm RETURNING on Sunday'        (qachon
                                       ketadi)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a destination = manzil, boradigan joy
  to report     = xabar bermoq
  an experience = tajriba, boshdan kechirilgan
                  voqea
  friendly      = do'stona

exercises.instructionEn: Imagine you are on holiday. Use the plan below to write a letter to a friend telling him/her about your holiday (80-120 words). Use the letter in Ex. 4 as a model.
exercises.instructionUz: Ta'tildasiz deb tasavvur qiling. Quyidagi rejadan foydalanib, do'stingizga ta'tilingiz haqida xat yozing (80-120 so'z). 4-mashqdagi xatni namuna sifatida oling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI REJA:

  Dear + (do'stingizning ismi,)

  KIRISh (Introduction)
  1-xatboshi:  Where are you?
               When did you arrive there?
               What is the weather like?
               Where are you staying?

  ASOSIY QISM (Main Body)
  2-xatboshi:  What things have you done?
               When did you do them?
               What was each like?

  3-xatboshi:  What haven't you done yet?
               What are you going to do?

  YAKUN (Conclusion)
  4-xatboshi:  What do you think of the place?
               When are you leaving?

  Best wishes/Love, etc
  (o'z ismingiz)


TO'LIQ NAMUNA XAT (≈115 so'z):

  ─────────────────────────────────────────
  Dear Aziz,

  Greetings from Istanbul! I arrived here last
  Tuesday and I'm having a wonderful time. The
  weather is warm and sunny. I'm staying at a
  small hotel near the Blue Mosque.

  I've already done a lot of things. I've
  visited the Topkapi Palace — I went there on
  Wednesday and it was amazing. I've also been
  to the Grand Bazaar. I went there yesterday
  and bought some handmade souvenirs. It was
  very noisy and crowded!

  I haven't been on a boat trip on the
  Bosphorus yet, and I haven't tried Turkish
  coffee. We are going to do both tomorrow.

  Istanbul is a fascinating city — you must
  visit it one day! I'm returning home on
  Sunday.

                            Best wishes,
                            Nodir
  ─────────────────────────────────────────


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  Hurmatli Aziz,

  Istanbuldan salom! Bu yerga o'tgan seshanba
  kuni keldim va ajoyib vaqt o'tkazyapman.
  Havo iliq va quyoshli. Ko'k masjid yonidagi
  kichik mehmonxonada turibman.

  Allaqachon ko'p ish qildim. To'pqopi
  saroyiga borganman — u yerga chorshanba kuni
  bordim va hayratlanarli edi. Katta bozorga
  ham borganman. U yerga kecha bordim va
  qo'lbola sovg'alar sotib oldim. Juda
  shovqinli va gavjum edi!

  Hali Bosfor bo'ylab qayiqda sayohat
  qilmadim va turk qahvasini yeb ko'rmadim.
  Ertaga ikkalasini ham qilamiz.

  Istanbul — maftunkor shahar, bir kun kelib
  albatta borishing kerak! Yakshanba kuni
  uyga qaytaman.

                    Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
                    Nodir
  ─────────────────────────────────────────


SO'Z HISOBI:
  Namuna xat ≈115 so'z — talab qilingan
  80-120 oralig'ida.

  Har xatboshi ≈25-30 so'z bo'lsa yetarli.


⚠ HAR XATBOShIDA QAYSI ZAMON:

  1-xatboshi:
     'I ARRIVED here last Tuesday'
        → PAST SIMPLE (aniq vaqt)
     'I'M HAVING a wonderful time'
        → PRESENT CONTINUOUS (hozir)
     'The weather IS warm'
        → PRESENT SIMPLE
     'I'M STAYING at a hotel'
        → PRESENT CONTINUOUS (vaqtinchalik)

  2-xatboshi:
     'I've ALREADY DONE a lot of things'
        → PRESENT PERFECT
     'I've VISITED the Topkapi Palace'
        → PRESENT PERFECT
     'I WENT there ON WEDNESDAY'
        → PAST SIMPLE (aniq vaqt)
     'it WAS amazing'
        → PAST SIMPLE (baho)

  3-xatboshi:
     'I HAVEN'T BEEN ... YET'
        → PRESENT PERFECT INKOR
     'We ARE GOING TO DO both tomorrow'
        → BE GOING TO (reja)

  4-xatboshi:
     'Istanbul IS a fascinating city'
        → PRESENT SIMPLE (fikr)
     'I'M RETURNING home on Sunday'
        → PRESENT CONTINUOUS (aniq reja)


FOYDALI IBORALAR — HAR XATBOShI UChUN:

  1-XATBOShI:
     'Greetings from [shahar]!'
     'I arrived here last [kun].'
     'I'm having a wonderful time.'
     'The weather is [sifat].'
     'I'm staying at/with ...'

  2-XATBOShI:
     'I've already visited ...'
     'I've also been to ...'
     'I went there on [kun].'
     'It was [sifat].'

  3-XATBOShI:
     'I haven't ... yet.'
     'We are going to ... tomorrow.'

  4-XATBOShI:
     '... is a fascinating city.'
     'You must visit it one day!'
     'I'm returning home on [kun].'
     'Best wishes,' / 'Love,'


DIQQAT — 'BEST WISHES' va 'LOVE':
  'Best wishes,'  — do'st, tanish
  'Love,'         — yaqin do'st, oila
  'Yours,'        — neytral

  Rasmiy xatda: 'Yours sincerely,' /
  'Yours faithfully,'


DIQQAT — VERGUL:
  'Dear Aziz,'      — vergul bilan
  'Best wishes,'    — vergul bilan
  Keyin ism keyingi qatorda.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an introduction = kirish
  the main body   = asosiy qism
  a conclusion    = yakun
  to leave        = ketmoq
  a destination   = manzil

1-XATBOSHI (Introduction) — TO'RT savolga
javob: qayerda, qachon keldi, havo, qayerda
turadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI MAQOL:


 1  'HE TRAVELS FASTEST WHO TRAVELS ALONE.'

    So'zma-so'z:
    'Yolg'iz sayohat qilgan eng tez
     sayohat qiladi.'

    O'zbekchada eng yaqin ma'no:
    'Yolg'iz yurgan tez yetar.'

    MA'NOSI:
    Yolg'iz odam boshqalarni kutmaydi,
    kelishmaydi, muhokama qilmaydi —
    shuning uchun tezroq harakat qiladi.

    Keng ma'noda: hamroh yoki sherik bo'lsa,
    qaror sekinlashadi.

    GRAMMATIKASI — G'ALATI SO'Z TARTIBI:
       Odatdagi tartib:
          'He WHO travels alone travels
           fastest.'
       Maqolda esa:
          'He travels fastest WHO travels
           alone.'

       'who travels alone' ergash gapi
       gap OXIRIGA ko'chirilgan — she'riy,
       ta'sirchan bo'lishi uchun.

       'HE WHO ...' — 'kimki ...' degan
       eskicha qurilma (maqollarda ko'p
       uchraydi).

    Kelib chiqishi: Rudyard Kiplingning
    'The Winners' she'ridan (1890).


 2  'TRAVEL BROADENS THE MIND.'

    So'zma-so'z:
    'Sayohat ongni kengaytiradi.'

    O'zbekchada eng yaqin maqol:
    'Ko'p yurgan ko'p biladi.'
    'Ko'p o'qigandan ko'p yurgan afzal.'

    MA'NOSI:
    Yangi joylarni ko'rish, boshqa
    madaniyatlar bilan tanishish odamning
    dunyoqarashini kengaytiradi, fikrini
    o'zgartiradi.

    GRAMMATIKASI:
       'TRAVEL' — bu yerda OT va
       SANALMAYDIGAN (umumiy ma'noda
       'sayohat qilish'), shuning uchun
       artikl YO'Q va fe'l -S oladi:
          'Travel BROADENS ...'  ✓
          'Travels broaden ...'  ✗

       'to BROADEN' = kengaytirmoq
       broad (keng) + -EN (fe'l yasovchi)

       'the MIND' = ong, aql
       'the' bilan — umumiy tushuncha
       sifatida.


DIQQAT — '-EN' FE'L YASOVChI QO'ShIMChA:
  broad  →  broadEN   (kengaytirmoq)
  wide   →  widEN     (kengaytirmoq)
  short  →  shortEN   (qisqartirmoq)
  strong →  strengthEN (mustahkamlamoq)
  deep   →  deepEN    (chuqurlashtirmoq)
  weak   →  weakEN    (kuchsizlantirmoq)

  Sifatdan FE'L yasaydi.


IKKI MAQOL BIR-BIRIGA ZIDMI?
  1-maqol: yolg'iz yur — tez yetasan
  2-maqol: sayohat qil — aqling kengayadi

  Zid emas: birinchisi TEZLIK haqida,
  ikkinchisi FOYDA haqida.

  Lekin qiziq: birinchisi yolg'izlikni
  maqtaydi, ikkinchisi esa sayohatning
  o'zini.


BOG'LIQLIK — UNIT MAVZUSI:
  Butun Unit 15 SAYOHAT haqida (Qohira,
  Madrid, Parij, Amerika mehmonxonalari).

  Bu maqollar unitni yakunlaydi: sayohat
  nima uchun qilinadi degan savolga javob.


DIQQAT — MAQOLLAR TARJIMA QILINMAYDI:
  Har tilda O'Z muqobili bor. So'zma-so'z
  o'girish ko'pincha ma'nosiz bo'ladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to travel  = sayohat qilmoq
  travel     = sayohat (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  fastest    = eng tez
  alone      = yolg'iz
  to broaden = kengaytirmoq
  broad      = keng
  the mind   = ong, aql
  wisdom     = donishmandlik

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni to'ldirish uchun ro'yxatdan so'z tanlang, so'ngra ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta so'z, har biri BIR marta):
  rode, handmade, fascinating, centre, huge,
  boat, traditional, wonderful


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  HUGE temples
  2  having a WONDERFUL time
  3  in the CENTRE of Cairo
  4  TRADITIONAL restaurant
  5  HANDMADE souvenirs
  6  a BOAT trip
  7  I RODE a camel
  8  a FASCINATING city


HAMMASI XATDAN OLINGAN:
  1  'its HUGE temples and statues'
  2  'I'm having a WONDERFUL time'
  3  'He lives in the CENTRE of Cairo'
  4  'I've been to a TRADITIONAL restaurant'
  5  'some lovely HANDMADE souvenirs'
  6  'a BOAT trip down the River Nile'
  7  'I even RODE a camel'
  8  'Cairo is a FASCINATING city'


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — IKKI GURUH:

  YETTITASI SIFAT yoki OT ANIQLOVChISI
  (otdan OLDIN turadi):
     HUGE temples
     WONDERFUL time
     TRADITIONAL restaurant
     HANDMADE souvenirs
     BOAT trip
     FASCINATING city
     CENTRE (of Cairo — ot)

  BITTASI FE'L:
     'I RODE a camel'
     Ro'yxatdagi yagona FE'L shakli —
     'rode' (ride ning o'tgan zamoni).
     Bo'shliqdan oldin 'I' bor, demak FE'L
     kerak!


ENG NOZIK JOY — 7-BAND:
  'I ................ a camel'

  Bo'shliqdan oldin EGA ('I'), keyin
  TO'LDIRUVCHI ('a camel') — orasida FE'L
  bo'lishi shart.

  Ro'yxatda faqat BITTA fe'l bor: RODE.


DIQQAT — 3-BAND, 'CENTRE':
  'in the CENTRE of Cairo'

  'centre' — britancha yozilishi.
  Amerikacha: 'center'.

  Shu kabi: theatre/theater, metre/meter,
  litre/liter.


DIQQAT — 'BOAT TRIP' — OT + OT:
  'a BOAT trip' — birinchi ot ikkinchisini
  aniqlaydi (qanday sayohat? — qayiqda).

  Shu kabi: a bus stop, a school bag,
  a football match.

  DIQQAT: birinchi ot KO'PLIKDA bo'lmaydi:
     'a boat trip'  ✓
     'a boats trip' ✗


DIQQAT — 'HANDMADE':
  hand + made = qo'l bilan yasalgan
  Qo'shma sifat, birga yoziladi.

  Shu kabi: homemade (uyda tayyorlangan),
  handwritten (qo'lda yozilgan).


DIQQAT — 'FASCINATING' va 'FASCINATED':
  'a FASCINATING city' = maftunkor shahar
     (-ING: narsaning XUSUSIYATI)
  'I am FASCINATED' = men maftun bo'ldim
     (-ED: odamning HISSI)

  Shu kabi: interesting/interested,
  boring/bored, exciting/excited.


GAP TUZISh — NAMUNA GAPLAR:

 1  Luxor is famous for its HUGE TEMPLES.
 2  We are having a WONDERFUL TIME in Egypt.
 3  My hotel is IN THE CENTRE OF the city.
 4  We ate at a TRADITIONAL RESTAURANT last
    night.
 5  I bought some HANDMADE SOUVENIRS at the
    bazaar.
 6  We are going on a BOAT TRIP tomorrow.
 7  I RODE A CAMEL near the Pyramids.
 8  Cairo is a FASCINATING CITY.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  huge        = ulkan
  wonderful   = ajoyib
  the centre  = markaz
  traditional = an'anaviy
  handmade    = qo'lbola
  a boat trip = qayiqda sayohat
  to ride     = minmoq (ride → RODE)
  fascinating = maftunkor

tasks.whyUz:
XATDAN: 'The place is famous for its HUGE
TEMPLES and statues.'

Ma'badlar QANDAY? — ulkan.
'huge' = juda katta (very big dan kuchliroq).

tasks.prompt: 2  having a ............ time
tasks.whyUz:
XATDAN: 'I'm having a WONDERFUL TIME.'

'to have a wonderful/good/great time' —
turg'un ibora (ajoyib vaqt o'tkazmoq).

6-mashqda uning ziddi so'raladi: 'horrible'.

tasks.prompt: 3  in the .......... of Cairo
tasks.whyUz:
XATDAN: 'He lives IN THE CENTRE OF Cairo.'

'centre' — bu ro'yxatdagi yagona OT
(qolganlari sifat yoki fe'l).
'in the centre OF' — ikki predlog.

DIQQAT: 'centre' britancha;
amerikacha 'center'.

XATDAN: 'I've been to a TRADITIONAL
RESTAURANT.'

Restoran QANDAY? — an'anaviy (mahalliy
taomlar beriladigan).

6-mashqda uning ziddi so'raladi: 'modern'.

XATDAN: 'I bought some lovely HANDMADE
SOUVENIRS there.'

Sovg'alar QANDAY? — qo'lda yasalgan.

'handmade' = hand + made (qo'shma sifat,
BIRGA yoziladi).
Shu kabi: homemade, handwritten.

XATDAN: 'a BOAT TRIP down the River Nile'

'a boat trip' — OT + OT birikmasi
(qanday sayohat? — qayiqda).

DIQQAT: birinchi ot KO'PLIKDA bo'lmaydi:
  'a boat trip'  ✓
  'a boats trip' ✗

Shu kabi: a bus stop, a school bag.

XATDAN: 'I even RODE A CAMEL. It was fun!'

⚠ ENG NOZIK BAND:
Bo'shliqdan oldin EGA ('I'), keyin
TO'LDIRUVCHI ('a camel') — orasida FE'L
kerak.

Ro'yxatdagi YAGONA fe'l — RODE.
Qolgan hammasi sifat yoki ot.

ride → RODE → RIDDEN (noto'g'ri fe'l).

XATDAN: 'Cairo is a FASCINATING CITY.'

Shahar QANDAY? — maftunkor, qiziqarli.

DIQQAT — '-ING' va '-ED' FARQI:
  'a FASCINATING city' — narsaning XUSUSIYATI
  'I am FASCINATED' — odamning HISSI

Shu kabi: interesting/interested,
boring/bored.

exercises.instructionEn: Replace the adjectives in bold with their opposites.
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin harfdagi sifatlarni ularning ziddi bilan almashtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
ZID SO'ZLAR RO'YXATI (6 ta):
  disgusting, cold, quiet, horrible, empty,
  modern


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  I'm having a WONDERFUL time.
    → I'm having a HORRIBLE time.

 2  The streets are NOISY and CROWDED.
    → The streets are QUIET and EMPTY.

 3  We've been to a TRADITIONAL restaurant.
    → We've been to a MODERN restaurant.

 4  The food was DELICIOUS.
    → The food was DISGUSTING.

 5  The weather is very HOT.
    → The weather is very COLD.


OLTI ZID JUFTLIK:

  wonderful   ↔  horrible
  (ajoyib)       (dahshatli)

  noisy       ↔  quiet
  (shovqinli)    (jim, tinch)

  crowded     ↔  empty
  (gavjum)       (bo'sh)

  traditional ↔  modern
  (an'anaviy)    (zamonaviy)

  delicious   ↔  disgusting
  (juda mazali)  (jirkanch, badbo'y)

  hot         ↔  cold
  (issiq)        (sovuq)


DIQQAT — 2-BANDDA IKKI SIFAT:
  'The streets are NOISY and CROWDED.'
  Ikkalasi ham qalin harfda, demak
  IKKALASINI ham almashtirish kerak:
     noisy   → quiet
     crowded → empty

  Boshqa bandlarda bittadan.
  Jami 6 sifat, 6 zid so'z — teng.


HAMMASI XATDAN OLINGAN:
  1  'I'm having a WONDERFUL time'
  2  'how NOISY and CROWDED it was'
  3  'a TRADITIONAL restaurant'
  4  'the food was just DELICIOUS'
  5  'The weather is very HOT here'

  Ya'ni bu mashq — xatning TESKARI
  variantini yozish.


DIQQAT — 'DELICIOUS' va 'DISGUSTING':
  delicious  = juda mazali (ovqat haqida)
  disgusting = jirkanch, badbo'y

  'disgusting' — juda kuchli salbiy so'z.
  Yumshoqrog'i: 'not very nice', 'awful'.


DIQQAT — 'QUIET' va 'QUITE' — ADAShTIRMANG!
  QUIET  /ˈkwaɪət/  = jim, tinch (SIFAT)
  QUITE  /kwaɪt/    = ancha (RAVISH)

  'a quiet street'  = tinch ko'cha
  'quite noisy'     = ancha shovqinli

  Yozilishi juda o'xshash, ma'nosi butunlay
  boshqa!


DIQQAT — 'CROWDED' va 'EMPTY':
  crowded = odam to'la, gavjum
  empty   = bo'sh (hech kim/narsa yo'q)

  'a crowd' = olomon (OT)
  'crowded' = gavjum (SIFAT)


DIQQAT — 'HORRIBLE':
  Unit 14 da ham bor edi (99 va 103-betlar):
  'It looks and smells HORRIBLE.'

  'wonderful' ning ziddi sifatida
  'terrible', 'awful' ham bo'lardi, lekin
  ro'yxatda 'horrible' berilgan.


TO'LIQ TESKARI XAT (mashqning natijasi):
  'The weather is very COLD here and I'm
   having a HORRIBLE time. The streets are
   QUIET and EMPTY. We've been to a MODERN
   restaurant. The food was DISGUSTING.'

  Ya'ni butunlay teskari ta'til!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  horrible   = dahshatli
  quiet      = jim, tinch
  empty      = bo'sh
  modern     = zamonaviy
  disgusting = jirkanch
  cold       = sovuq
  crowded    = gavjum
  delicious  = juda mazali

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing prepositions, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Yetishmayotgan predloglarni qo'ying, so'ngra ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR RO'YXATI (5 ta):
  for, down, on, with, at

DIQQAT: OLTI bo'shliq bor, lekin BESH
predlog — demak BITTASI IKKI marta
ishlatiladi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  I'm staying WITH my friend
  2  ON Tuesday
  3  AT Giza
  4  go ON a boat trip DOWN the River Nile
  5  famous FOR

  'ON' IKKI marta ishlatiladi (2 va 4).


HAMMASI XATDAN OLINGAN:
  1  'I'm staying WITH my friend, Abdullah.'
  2  'We visited it ON Tuesday.'
  3  'the Pyramids and the Sphinx AT Giza'
  4  'a boat trip DOWN the River Nile' /
     'We are going ON a boat trip tomorrow'
  5  'The place is famous FOR its huge temples'


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'STAY WITH somebody' = birovnikida turmoq
    'with' — hamrohlik.
    DIQQAT: 'stay AT a hotel' (joy),
    lekin 'stay WITH a friend' (odam).

 2  'ON Tuesday' — HAFTA KUNLARI 'on' bilan:
       on Monday, on Friday, on Sunday
    Boshqa vaqt predloglari:
       IN + oy/yil/fasl (in May, in 2010)
       AT + soat (at 5 o'clock)

 3  'AT Giza' — kichik joy nomi 'at' bilan.
    'AT' — aniq nuqta.
    ('IN Cairo' — katta shahar; 'AT Giza' —
     aniq joy.)

 4  IKKI PREDLOG:
    'go ON a boat trip' — sayohatga chiqmoq
       ('on a trip / on holiday / on a
        journey' — turg'un)
    'DOWN the River Nile' — daryo BO'YLAB
       (oqim yo'nalishida)
       Teskarisi: 'UP the river'

 5  'FAMOUS FOR something' = ... bilan mashhur
    'famous FOR its temples'

    DIQQAT: 'famous AS' — boshqa ma'no
    ('He is famous AS a singer' = qo'shiqchi
     sifatida mashhur).


VAQT PREDLOGLARI — QISQA JADVAL:

  AT  →  soat, aniq vaqt
         at 5 o'clock, at night, at noon
  ON  →  kun, sana
         on Tuesday, on 5th May, on Monday
         morning
  IN  →  oy, yil, fasl, qism
         in May, in 2010, in summer,
         in the morning

  DIQQAT — ISTISNO:
     'in the morning' — 'IN' bilan
     'ON Monday morning' — 'ON' bilan
     (kun qo'shilsa 'on' bo'ladi!)


JOY PREDLOGLARI — QISQA JADVAL:

  AT  →  aniq nuqta: at Giza, at the door,
         at the bus stop, at home
  IN  →  ichida: in Cairo, in the room,
         in Egypt
  ON  →  yuzasida: on the table, on the wall


GAP TUZISh — NAMUNA GAPLAR:

 1  I'm staying WITH my friend in Cairo.
 2  We visited the bazaar ON Tuesday.
 3  The Pyramids and the Sphinx are AT Giza.
 4  We are going ON a boat trip DOWN the
    River Nile.
 5  Luxor is famous FOR its huge temples and
    statues.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to stay with = birovnikida turmoq
  Giza         = Giza (ehromlar joylashgan joy)
  to go on a trip = sayohatga chiqmoq
  down the river = daryo bo'ylab
  famous for   = ... bilan mashhur

tasks.prompt: 1  I'm staying ...... my friend
tasks.whyUz:
'STAY WITH somebody' = birovnikida turmoq.
'with' — hamrohlik bildiradi.

DIQQAT — FARQI:
  'stay WITH a friend' (ODAM bilan)
  'stay AT a hotel'    (JOYDA)

Xatdan: 'I'm staying WITH my friend,
Abdullah.'

tasks.prompt: 2  ...... Tuesday
tasks.whyUz:
HAFTA KUNLARI DOIM 'ON' bilan:
  on Monday, on Tuesday, on Sunday

VAQT PREDLOGLARI:
  AT + soat  (at 5 o'clock)
  ON + kun   (on Tuesday)
  IN + oy/yil (in May, in 2010)

Xatdan: 'We visited it ON Tuesday.'

'AT' — aniq, kichik joy uchun.

FARQI:
  'IN Cairo'  — katta shahar (ichida)
  'AT Giza'   — aniq joy/nuqta

Xatdan: 'the Pyramids and the Sphinx AT GIZA'

Giza — Qohira yaqinidagi joy, u yerda uchta
buyuk ehrom va Sfenks bor.

tasks.prompt: 4a  go ...... a boat trip
tasks.whyUz:
'GO ON a trip' — TURG'UN ibora.

Shu kabi:
  go ON holiday, go ON a journey,
  go ON a boat trip, go ON an excursion

DIQQAT: 'on' bu mashqda IKKI marta ishlatiladi
(2 va 4a-bandlar) — chunki 6 bo'shliq, 5 predlog.

Xatdan: 'We are GOING ON A BOAT TRIP
tomorrow.'

tasks.prompt: 4b  ...... the River Nile
tasks.whyUz:
'DOWN the river' = daryo BO'YLAB
(oqim yo'nalishida).

Teskarisi: 'UP the river' (oqimga qarshi).

Nil JANUBDAN SHIMOLGA oqadi, shuning uchun
'down the Nile' — shimolga qarab.

Xatdan: 'a boat trip DOWN THE RIVER NILE'

tasks.prompt: 5  famous ......
tasks.whyUz:
'FAMOUS FOR something' = ... bilan mashhur.

DIQQAT — 'FAMOUS AS' BILAN ADASHTIRMANG:
  'famous FOR its temples' = ma'badlari bilan
     mashhur (NARSA)
  'famous AS a singer' = qo'shiqchi sifatida
     mashhur (KIM sifatida)

Xatdan: 'The place is FAMOUS FOR its huge
temples and statues.'

    'Have you ever DRIVEN a bus?'
    (106-bet, 12-mashq)
    'No, I've never DRIVEN a bus.'

 8  YET (hali)
    'I haven't been on a boat trip YET.'
    (105 va 106-betlar)

 9  ALREADY (allaqachon)
    'I've ALREADY visited the bazaar.'
    (105 va 106-betlar)

10  TIP (choychaqa)
    'It's a good idea to TIP a bellboy at
     least $5.'
    (108-bet)

11  BELLBOY (mehmonxona xizmatchisi)
    'Tip your BELLBOY generously and you'll
     have the perfect holiday.'
    (108-bet)

12  BOOK A TABLE (stol band qilmoq)
    'I'd like to BOOK A TABLE for tonight,
     please.'
    (107 va 108-betlar)


DIQQAT — RO'YXAT BUTUN UNITNI QAMRAB OLADI:
  1, 4, 5, 6  →  105-bet (Jekning xati)
  2, 8, 9     →  106-107-betlar (grammatika)
  3, 7        →  106-107-betlar (Present
                 Perfect mashqlari)
  10, 11      →  108-bet (Tipping in America)
  12          →  107-108-betlar (muloqot)


DIQQAT — 'HAVE VISITED' RO'YXATDA:
  Bu — YAGONA to'liq fe'l shakli
  (qolganlari alohida so'zlar).

  Kitob ataylab Present Perfect shaklini
  bergan — o'quvchi uni to'g'ri gapda
  ishlatishi kerak:
     'I have visited ...'  ✓
     'I have visited yesterday.'  ✗
       (aniq vaqt bilan Present Perfect
        ishlatilmaydi!)


DIQQAT — 'DRIVE' NING ShAKLLARI:
  drive → drove → DRIVEN

  Present Perfect da: 'I have DRIVEN'
  Past Simple da:     'I DROVE'


O'YIN QOIDALARI:
  • Ikki jamoa
  • NAVBATMA-NAVBAT ('take it in turns')
  • Har to'g'ri gap = 1 ochko
  • Eng ko'p ochko — g'olib


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a team    = jamoa
  a point   = ochko
  a winner  = g'olib

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  C (work)
   2  A (visited)
   3  B (have tidied)
   4  B (is listening)
   5  A (went)
   6  C (has been)
   7  A (watch)
   8  C (is reading)
   9  A (bought)
  10  B (goes)


ZAMONLAR BO'YIChA GURUHLAR:

  PRESENT SIMPLE — 1, 7, 10
     (doimiy, odat)
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS — 4, 8
     ('right now', 'at the moment')
  PAST SIMPLE — 2, 5, 9
     ('last weekend', 'last summer',
      'last month')
  PRESENT PERFECT — 3, 6
     (natija hozir ko'rinadi; 'for six years')


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'I'm a bellboy. I ... in a hotel.'
    DOIMIY ish (kasb) → PRESENT SIMPLE.
    → C (work)
    ('am working' — vaqtinchalik degan ma'no
     berardi.)

 2  'He ... his sister LAST WEEKEND.'
    'last weekend' → PAST SIMPLE.
    → A (visited)

 3  'I ... my room. Can I watch TV, NOW?'
    Ish TUGAGAN va natijasi HOZIR muhim
    ('endi televizor ko'rsam bo'ladimi?')
    → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → B (have tidied)

 4  'She ... to music RIGHT NOW.'
    'right now' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → B (is listening)

 5  'We ... to Canada LAST SUMMER.'
    'last summer' → PAST SIMPLE.
    → A (went)

 6  'Julie ... a chef FOR SIX YEARS.'
    'for six years' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → C (has been)
    ('be' va 'been' — yordamchi fe'lsiz
     ishlatilmaydi.)

 7  'I USUALLY ... TV EVERY AFTERNOON.'
    'usually', 'every afternoon' → odat
    → PRESENT SIMPLE.
    → A (watch)

 8  'She ... a book AT THE MOMENT.'
    'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → C (is reading)

 9  'Joe ... some souvenirs LAST MONTH.'
    'last month' → PAST SIMPLE.
    → A (bought)

10  'My father ALWAYS ... to work by bus.'
    'always' → odat → PRESENT SIMPLE.
    Ega 'My father' — III shaxs BIRLIK
    → fe'lga -S: GOES.
    → B (goes)


⚠ 10-BAND — ENG NOZIK:
  'My father' — III shaxs BIRLIK,
  shuning uchun 'go' emas, 'GOES'.

  A (go) — grammatik jihatdan noto'g'ri.
  C (is going) — 'always' bilan mos kelmaydi.


VAQT IBORALARI — QISQA JADVAL:

  PRESENT SIMPLE:
     always, usually, often, sometimes,
     never, every day/afternoon

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
     now, right now, at the moment,
     today, this week

  PAST SIMPLE:
     yesterday, last week/month/summer,
     ... ago, in 2010

  PRESENT PERFECT:
     ever, never, just, yet, already,
     for, since


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a bellboy = mehmonxona xizmatchisi
  to tidy   = yig'ishtirmoq
  a chef    = oshpaz
  by bus    = avtobusda

tasks.prompt: 1  I'm a bellboy. I ..................... in a hotel.  A worked  B am working  C work
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'I'M A BELLBOY' — bu DOIMIY kasb.
Doimiy holat → PRESENT SIMPLE.

'am working' — vaqtinchalik degan ma'no
berardi.
'worked' — o'tgan zamon, 'I'm a bellboy' ga zid.

tasks.prompt: 2  He ..................... his sister last weekend.  A visited  B is visiting  C visit
tasks.promptUz: U o'tgan dam olish kunlari opasinikiga bordi.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'LAST WEEKEND' — ANIQ VAQT
→ PAST SIMPLE.

tasks.prompt: 3  I ..................... my room. Can I watch TV, now?  A tidy  B have tidied  C am tidying
tasks.promptUz: Xonamni yig'ishtirdim. Endi televizor ko'rsam bo'ladimi?
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'NOW' — ish TUGAGAN va natijasi
HOZIR muhim ('endi televizor ko'rsam
bo'ladimi?').

→ PRESENT PERFECT.

'am tidying' bo'lsa hali yig'ishtirayotgan
bo'lardi — televizor so'rash mantiqsiz.
tidy → TIDIED.

tasks.prompt: 4  She ..................... to music right now.  A listen  B is listening  C listened
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'RIGHT NOW' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'listen TO music' — predlog 'to'.

tasks.prompt: 5  We ..................... to Canada last summer.  A went  B go  C am going
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'LAST SUMMER' → PAST SIMPLE.
go → WENT.

tasks.prompt: 6  Julie ..................... a chef for six years.  A be  B been  C has been
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'FOR SIX YEARS' → PRESENT PERFECT.

A ('be') va B ('been') — yordamchi fe'lsiz
ishlatilmaydi:
  'Julie been a chef' ✗
  'Julie HAS BEEN a chef' ✓

Hozir HAM oshpaz (IKKINCHI qo'llanish).

tasks.prompt: 7  I usually ..................... TV every afternoon.  A watch  B am watching  C watched
tasks.promptUz: Men odatda har kuni tushdan keyin televizor ko'raman.
tasks.whyUz:
IKKI KALIT: 'USUALLY' va 'EVERY AFTERNOON'
— ODAT → PRESENT SIMPLE.

Ega 'I' — -S QO'SHILMAYDI.

tasks.prompt: 8  She ..................... a book at the moment.  A reads  B read  C is reading
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'AT THE MOMENT' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

4-band bilan bir xil qoida
('right now' = 'at the moment').

tasks.prompt: 9  Joe ..................... some souvenirs in London last month.  A bought  B buy  C is buying
tasks.promptUz: Jo o'tgan oyda Londonda sovg'alar sotib oldi.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'LAST MONTH' → PAST SIMPLE.
buy → BOUGHT.

tasks.prompt: 10  My father always ..................... to work by bus.  A go  B goes  C is going
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'ALWAYS' — ODAT → PRESENT SIMPLE.

⚠ EGA 'MY FATHER' — III SHAXS BIRLIK,
shuning uchun fe'lga -S: GOES.

A ('go') — grammatik jihatdan XATO.
C ('is going') — 'always' bilan mos kelmaydi.

'BY bus' — transport 'by' bilan, artiklsiz.

exercises.instructionUz: Qavs ichidagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  HAD              (NAMUNA)
 2  COMES
 3  WILL TAKE / 'LL TAKE
 4  DIDN'T PLAY
 5  DO YOU WANT
 6  IS SLEEPING
 7  WILL HELP / 'LL HELP
 8  DOES
 9  HAS JIM PAID
10  IS WASHING
11  HAVE JUST TURNED
12  HAVE YOU WORKED
13  HASN'T TRAVELLED
14  DON'T WE GO
15  DID YOU HEAR


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'We HAD chicken for dinner LAST NIGHT.'
    'last night' → PAST SIMPLE. (NAMUNA)

 2  'My father ALWAYS ... home at 6 pm.'
    'always' → ODAT → PRESENT SIMPLE.
    Ega 'My father' → -S: COMES.

 3  'Finish your homework and I ... you to the
     park.'
    Shart-natija: agar tugatsang, olib boraman.
    Va'da → WILL.
    → WILL TAKE

 4  'Sara ... football with us YESTERDAY.'
    'yesterday' → PAST SIMPLE INKOR.
    → DIDN'T PLAY
    (DIQQAT: 'didn't' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl!)

 5  '... something to drink?'
    'want' — HIS fe'li, Continuous bo'lmaydi.
    Savol → PRESENT SIMPLE.
    → DO YOU WANT

 6  'Please be quiet! The baby ...'
    Ayni damda uxlayapti → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → IS SLEEPING

 7  'OK! I ... you with your maths.'
    'OK!' — qaror AYNI DAMDA qabul qilinyapti
    → WILL.
    → WILL HELP

 8  'Jill ... the shopping EVERY SATURDAY
     MORNING.'
    'every Saturday morning' → ODAT →
    PRESENT SIMPLE.
    Ega 'Jill' → -S: DOES.

 9  '... the phone bill YET?'
    'yet' → PRESENT PERFECT savoli.
    → HAS JIM PAID
    (pay → PAID)

10  'Jason ... the car NOW.'
    'now' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → IS WASHING

11  'Don't touch the stove! I ... it on!'
    'just' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE JUST TURNED
    ('turn on' — ajraladigan fe'l)

12  'HOW LONG ... here?'
    'how long' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE YOU WORKED

13  'Nicole ... to Spain.'
    Vaqt aytilmagan, tajriba → PRESENT PERFECT
    INKOR.
    → HASN'T TRAVELLED

14  'The weather is nice. WHY ... to the
     beach?'
    'Why don't we ...?' — TAKLIF qilish shakli.
    → DON'T WE GO

15  'WHEN ... the bad news?'
    'when' — ANIQ VAQT so'ralyapti →
    PAST SIMPLE.
    → DID YOU HEAR


⚠ 14-BAND — MAXSUS QURILMA:
  'WHY DON'T WE go to the beach?'
  = plyajga borsak-chi?

  Bu — TAKLIF qilish shakli (Unit 14 dan):
     'Why don't you ...?' — sizga taklif
     'Why don't we ...?' — birgalikda taklif

  Qavsda '(not/we/go)' berilgani shuning
  uchun.


⚠ 15-BAND — 'WHEN' → PAST SIMPLE:
  'WHEN DID YOU HEAR the bad news?'

  'When HAVE you heard?' — XATO!
  'when' aniq vaqt so'raydi, shuning uchun
  Present Perfect ISHLATILMAYDI.

  Bu — Unit 15 ning eng muhim qoidasi
  (Coursebook 105-bet, Speaking bo'limi).


DIQQAT — 'DIDN'T' va 'HASN'T' DAN KEYIN:
   4  'Sara DIDN'T PLAY' — ASOSIY shakl
  13  'Nicole HASN'T TRAVELLED' — V3

  'didn't' + V1;  'hasn't' + V3.


DIQQAT — 'TURN ON' (11-band):
  'I've just turned IT ON.'
  Ajraladigan fe'l:
     turn it on   ✓
     turn on it   ✗

  'a stove' = plita, pech.


DIQQAT — 'TRAVELLED' (13-band):
  Britancha: travelLED (IKKI 'L').


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a stove      = plita, pech
  to turn on   = yoqmoq
  maths        = matematika
  the bad news = yomon xabar
  to hear      = eshitmoq (hear → HEARD)

tasks.prompt: 2  My father always ........................... (come) home at 6 pm.
tasks.promptUz: Dadam doim soat 6 da uyga keladi.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'ALWAYS' — ODAT → PRESENT SIMPLE.

Ega 'My father' — III shaxs BIRLIK → -S:
COMES.
tasks.speak: 2  My father always ........................... (come) home at 6 pm.

tasks.prompt: 3  Finish your homework and I ........................... (take) you to the park.
tasks.promptUz: Uy vazifangni tugat, men seni bog'ga olib boraman.
tasks.whyUz:
Shart-natija: agar tugatsang, olib boraman.
Bu — VA'DA → WILL.

Unit 13 dan: WILL — va'da va ayni damdagi
qaror.
tasks.speak: 3  Finish your homework and I ........................... (take) you to the park.

tasks.prompt: 4  Sara ........................... (not/play) football with us yesterday.
tasks.promptUz: Sara kecha biz bilan futbol o'ynamadi.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YESTERDAY' → PAST SIMPLE INKOR.

⚠ 'DIDN'T' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
  'didn't PLAY'   ✓
  'didn't PLAYED' ✗

tasks.prompt: 5  ........................... (you/want) something to drink?
tasks.whyUz:
'WANT' — HIS/XOHISH fe'li, Continuous
shaklda ISHLATILMAYDI → PRESENT SIMPLE.

'Are you wanting?' — XATO!

Shu kabi: like, love, hate, know, need.

tasks.prompt: 6  Please be quiet! The baby ..................... (sleep).
tasks.whyUz:
Ayni damda uxlayapti → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'Please be quiet!' — hozir sodir bo'layotgan
harakat borligini ko'rsatadi.

KALIT: 'OK!' — qaror AYNI DAMDA qabul
qilinyapti → WILL.

Unit 13 dan: WILL — ayni damdagi qaror.

'help somebody WITH something' — predlog
'with'.

tasks.prompt: 8  Jill ........................... (do) the shopping every Saturday morning.
tasks.promptUz: Jill har shanba ertalab xarid qiladi.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'EVERY SATURDAY MORNING' — ODAT
→ PRESENT SIMPLE.

Ega 'Jill' — III shaxs BIRLIK → DOES
('do' emas).
tasks.speak: 8  Jill ........................... (do) the shopping every Saturday morning.

tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT savoli.

HAS + ega + V3:
'HAS Jim PAID ...?'

pay → PAID (V2 = V3).

KALIT: 'NOW' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

DIQQAT — 8-mashqning 3-bandi bilan
solishtiring:
  'I HAVE TIDIED my room. Can I watch TV NOW?'
     (ish tugagan)
  'Jason IS WASHING the car NOW.'
     (ish davom etyapti)

KALIT: 'JUST' → PRESENT PERFECT.

'just' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.

'turn ON' — ajraladigan fe'l:
  'turned IT ON'  ✓
  'turned ON IT'  ✗

'a stove' = plita, pech.

tasks.promptUz: Bu yerda qancha vaqtdan beri ishlaysiz?
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'HOW LONG' → PRESENT PERFECT.

Grammar 66-bet, 7-mashqning 6-bandi bilan
bir xil.

tasks.prompt: 13  Nicole .......................... (not/travel) to Spain.
tasks.whyUz:
Vaqt AYTILMAGAN, TAJRIBA haqida
→ PRESENT PERFECT INKOR.

'hasn't' + V3: TRAVELLED.

DIQQAT — YOZILISHI:
travel → TRAVELLED (britancha, IKKI 'L').

tasks.prompt: 14  The weather is nice. Why ................................ (not/we/go) to the beach?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ MAXSUS QURILMA — TAKLIF QILISH:
'WHY DON'T WE go to the beach?'
= plyajga borsak-chi?

Unit 14 dan:
  'Why don't YOU ...?' — sizga taklif
  'Why don't WE ...?' — birgalikda taklif

Qavsda '(not/we/go)' berilgani shuning
uchun.
tasks.speak: 14  The weather is nice. Why ................................ (not/we/go) to the beach?

tasks.prompt: 15  When ......................... (you/hear) the bad news?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ KALIT: 'WHEN' — ANIQ VAQT so'ralyapti
→ PAST SIMPLE.

'When HAVE you heard?' — XATO!
Present Perfect ANIQ VAQT bilan
ishlatilmaydi.

Bu — Unit 15 ning eng muhim qoidasi
(Coursebook 105-bet, Speaking).

'did' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl: HEAR
('heard' EMAS).

exercises.instructionEn: Match the questions to the answers, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Savollarni javoblarga moslang, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  f      6  b
   2  d      7  j
   3  h      8  c
   4  a      9  e
   5  i     10  g


⚠ OLTIN QOIDA — QISQA JAVOB SAVOLDAGI
YORDAMChI FE'LNI TAKRORLAYDI:

  'HAVE you ...?'  →  'No, I HAVEN'T.'   (1-f)
  'WILL it ...?'   →  'Yes, it WILL.'    (2-d)
  'DO you ...?'    →  'No, I DON'T.'     (4-a)
  'IS she ...?'    →  'Yes, she IS.'     (8-c)
  'ARE you ...?'   →  'No, I'M NOT.'     (9-e)

  Beshta bandni FAQAT shu qoida bilan topish
  mumkin!


QOLGAN BESh BAND — SAVOL SO'ZI BO'YIChA:

  'WHAT is she DOING right now?'
     → harakat kerak → 'She's READING.' (3-h)

  'HOW OFTEN do you visit?'
     → chastota kerak → 'ONCE A WEEK.' (5-i)

  'HOW LONG have you lived?'
     → muddat kerak → 'FOR FOUR YEARS.' (6-b)

  'WHEN DID you become?'
     → o'tgan vaqt kerak → 'SEVEN YEARS AGO.'
       (7-j)

  'WHEN ARE you leaving?'
     → kelajak vaqt kerak → 'TOMORROW.' (10-g)


⚠ 7 va 10-BANDLAR — ENG NOZIK JUFTLIK:

  Ikkalasi ham 'WHEN' bilan boshlanadi,
  lekin ZAMONI boshqa:

   7  'When DID you become a lawyer?'
         PAST SIMPLE (o'tgan)
      → 'Seven years AGO.' (o'tgan)

  10  'When ARE you LEAVING for Germany?'
         PRESENT CONTINUOUS (kelajak reja)
      → 'TOMORROW.' (kelajak)

  Ya'ni javob ham o'tmishga, ham kelajakka
  tegishli bo'lishi mumkin — savolning
  ZAMONI hal qiladi.


⚠ 5 va 6-BANDLAR — YANA BIR JUFTLIK:

   5  'HOW OFTEN do you visit your parents?'
      → CHASTOTA (necha marta)
      → 'Once a week.' (haftada bir marta)

   6  'HOW LONG have you lived in London?'
      → MUDDAT (qancha vaqtdan beri)
      → 'For four years.'

  'How often' ≠ 'How long'!


⚠ 8 va 9-BANDLAR — 'IS' va 'ARE':

   8  'IS SHE staying ...?'  → 'Yes, SHE IS.'
   9  'ARE YOU going ...?'   → 'No, I'M NOT.'

  DIQQAT: 'Are you' savoliga javob 'I am not'
  (ega o'zgaradi: 'you' → 'I').


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT (savol → javob):

 1  Have you ever been to Paris?
    → f  No, I haven't.        (NAMUNA)
 2  Will it rain tomorrow?
    → d  Yes, it will.
 3  What is she doing right now?
    → h  She's reading.
 4  Do you watch TV every day?
    → a  No, I don't.
 5  How often do you visit your parents?
    → i  Once a week.
 6  How long have you lived in London?
    → b  For four years.
 7  When did you become a lawyer?
    → j  Seven years ago.
 8  Is she staying at Karen's house?
    → c  Yes, she is.
 9  Are you going to Hungary?
    → e  No, I'm not.
10  When are you leaving for Germany?
    → g  Tomorrow.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  How often ...? = necha marta? qanchalik
                   tez-tez?
  once a week    = haftada bir marta
  a lawyer       = yurist, advokat
  to become      = bo'lmoq (become → BECAME)
  to leave for   = ... ga jo'namoq
  Germany        = Germaniya

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense. — Laura's letter from Dublin
exercises.instructionUz: Qavs ichidagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying. — Lauraning Dublindan yozgan xati
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  IS
   2  AM HAVING
   3  AM STAYING
   4  HAVE BEEN
   5  HAVE ALREADY DONE
   6  HAVE SEEN
   7  WAS
   8  HAVE ALSO VISITED
   9  VISITED
  10  SHOWED
  11  HAVEN'T DONE
  12  HAVEN'T DONE
  13  HAVEN'T BEEN
  14  IS
  15  AM COMING
  16  WILL CALL / 'LL CALL


TO'LIQ XAT (javoblar bilan):

  Dear Andrea,

  Hello from Dublin! The weather IS fantastic
  and I AM HAVING a wonderful time. I AM
  STAYING at a comfortable hotel near the city
  centre. I HAVE BEEN here since Thursday and
  I HAVE ALREADY DONE many interesting things.
  I HAVE SEEN a play at the Abbey Theatre. It
  WAS very entertaining! I HAVE ALSO VISITED
  the Guinness Brewery. I VISITED it on
  Saturday. They SHOWED our tour group how
  they make beer.

  There are a lot of things I HAVEN'T DONE
  yet. I HAVEN'T DONE any shopping on Grafton
  Street yet and I HAVEN'T BEEN to any pubs
  yet.

  Dublin IS a very friendly city — you must
  visit it one day. I AM COMING back on the
  16th, so I WILL CALL you then.

                            Love,
                            Laura


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  Hurmatli Andrea,

  Dublindan salom! Havo ajoyib va men zo'r
  vaqt o'tkazyapman. Shahar markazi yonidagi
  qulay mehmonxonada turibman. Payshanbadan
  beri shu yerdaman va allaqachon ko'p
  qiziqarli ishlar qildim. Abbey teatrida
  spektakl ko'rdim. Juda maroqli edi!
  Guinness pivo zavodiga ham borganman.
  U yerga shanba kuni bordim. Ular bizning
  ekskursiya guruhimizga pivoni qanday
  tayyorlashni ko'rsatishdi.

  Hali qilmagan ko'p ishlarim bor. Grafton
  ko'chasida hali xarid qilmadim va hali
  hech qanday pabga bormadim.

  Dublin — juda do'stona shahar, bir kun
  kelib albatta borishing kerak. 16-sanada
  qaytaman, o'shanda senga qo'ng'iroq
  qilaman.

                    Mehr bilan, Laura


⚠ BU XAT — COURSEBOOK 105-BETDAGI JEKNING
XATINING AYNAN NUSXASI:

  Jek (Qohira):        Laura (Dublin):
  ────────────────     ─────────────────
  'The weather IS      'The weather IS
   very hot'            fantastic'
  'I'M HAVING a        'I AM HAVING a
   wonderful time'      wonderful time'
  'I'M STAYING with    'I AM STAYING at a
   my friend'           hotel'
  'I've BEEN here      'I HAVE BEEN here
   SINCE Monday'        SINCE Thursday'
  'I've ALREADY        'I HAVE ALREADY
   DONE lots of         DONE many
   things'              things'
  'I've ALREADY        'I HAVE SEEN a play'
   VISITED ...'
  'We VISITED it       'I VISITED it ON
   ON Tuesday'          Saturday'
  'I HAVEN'T BEEN      'I HAVEN'T BEEN to
   ... YET'             any pubs YET'
  'Cairo is a          'Dublin IS a very
   FASCINATING city'    FRIENDLY city'
  'I'M RETURNING ...   'I AM COMING back
   so I'LL CALL you     on the 16th, so I
   then'                WILL CALL you then'

  Kitob ataylab bir xil qolipni bergan!


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'The weather ... fantastic'
    Hozirgi holat → PRESENT SIMPLE. → IS

 2  'I ... a wonderful time'
    Hozir davom etayotgan → PRESENT
    CONTINUOUS. → AM HAVING

 3  'I ... at a comfortable hotel'
    VAQTINChALIK turish → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → AM STAYING

 4  'I ... here SINCE THURSDAY'
    'since' → PRESENT PERFECT. → HAVE BEEN

 5  'I ... (already/do) many things'
    'already' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE ALREADY DONE

 6  'I ... a play at the Abbey Theatre'
    Vaqt aytilmagan → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE SEEN

 7  'It ... very entertaining!'
    O'sha spektakl haqida BAHO → PAST SIMPLE.
    → WAS

 8  'I ... (also/visit) the Guinness Brewery'
    Vaqt aytilmagan → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE ALSO VISITED

 9  'I ... it ON SATURDAY'
    'on Saturday' — ANIQ VAQT → PAST SIMPLE.
    → VISITED

10  'They ... our tour group how they make
     beer'
    O'sha tashrif haqida → PAST SIMPLE.
    → SHOWED

11  'a lot of things I ... YET'
    'yet' → PRESENT PERFECT INKOR.
    → HAVEN'T DONE

12  'I ... any shopping ... YET'
    'yet' → PRESENT PERFECT INKOR.
    → HAVEN'T DONE

13  'I ... to any pubs YET'
    'yet' → PRESENT PERFECT INKOR.
    → HAVEN'T BEEN
    (DIQQAT: 'gone' EMAS — Grammar 65-bet
     qoidasi)

14  'Dublin ... a very friendly city'
    Doimiy holat → PRESENT SIMPLE. → IS

15  'I ... back ON THE 16TH'
    Aniq sanali REJA → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → AM COMING

16  'so I ... you then'
    VA'DA → WILL. → WILL CALL


⚠ ENG MUHIM NAQSh — 6/7 va 8/9:

   6  'I HAVE SEEN a play.'     (vaqt yo'q)
   7  'It WAS very entertaining!' (baho)

   8  'I HAVE ALSO VISITED the Brewery.'
                                 (vaqt yo'q)
   9  'I VISITED it ON SATURDAY.' (aniq vaqt)

  Present Perfect (xabar) → Past Simple
  (tafsilot/baho). Bu — Unit 15 ning oltin
  qoidasi.


DIQQAT — 11 va 12-BANDLAR IKKALASI HAM
'HAVEN'T DONE':
  11  'things I HAVEN'T DONE yet'
  12  'I HAVEN'T DONE any shopping'

  Ikkalasida ham 'do' fe'li, lekin
  to'ldiruvchisi boshqa.

  'do the shopping' = xarid qilmoq.


DIQQAT — 'ANY' INKORDA:
  'I haven't done ANY shopping.'
  'I haven't been to ANY pubs.'

  INKOR gapda 'some' emas, 'ANY'.


DUBLINDAGI JOYLAR:
  the Abbey Theatre — Irlandiyaning milliy
     teatri (1904-yildan)
  the Guinness Brewery — mashhur pivo zavodi
     (1759-yildan)
  Grafton Street — Dublinning asosiy xarid
     ko'chasi
  a pub — an'anaviy irland/ingliz bari


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Dublin        = Dublin (Irlandiya poytaxti)
  comfortable   = qulay
  the city centre = shahar markazi
  entertaining  = maroqli, qiziqarli
  a brewery     = pivo zavodi
  a tour group  = ekskursiya guruhi
  beer          = pivo
  a pub         = pab, bar
  friendly      = do'stona
  on the 16th   = 16-sanada

tasks.prompt: 1  The weather ......................... (be) fantastic
tasks.whyUz:
Hozirgi holat → PRESENT SIMPLE.

Coursebook 105-bet, Jekning xati:
'The weather IS very hot here.'

tasks.prompt: 2  and I ......................... (have) a wonderful time.
tasks.whyUz:
Hozir davom etayotgan → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'to have a wonderful time' — bu ma'noda
'have' Continuous BO'LADI
(egalik ma'nosida esa bo'lmaydi).

Jekning xati: 'I'M HAVING a wonderful time.'

tasks.prompt: 3  I ......................... (stay) at a comfortable hotel near the city centre.
tasks.promptUz: Shahar markazi yonidagi qulay mehmonxonada turibman.
tasks.whyUz:
VAQTINCHALIK turish → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'I stay at a hotel' — doimiy odat degan
ma'no berardi.

Jekning xati: 'I'M STAYING with my friend.'
tasks.speak: 3  I ......................... (stay) at a comfortable hotel near the city centre.

tasks.prompt: 4  I ......................... (be) here since Thursday
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'SINCE Thursday' → PRESENT PERFECT.

be → BEEN.

Jekning xati: 'I've BEEN here SINCE Monday.'

tasks.prompt: 5  and I ......................... (already/do) many interesting things.
tasks.promptUz: va allaqachon ko'p qiziqarli ishlar qildim.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'ALREADY' → PRESENT PERFECT.

'already' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.
do → DONE.

Jekning xati: 'I've ALREADY DONE lots of
things!'

tasks.prompt: 6  I ......................... (see) a play at the Abbey Theatre.
tasks.whyUz:
Vaqt AYTILMAGAN → PRESENT PERFECT.
see → SEEN.

⚠ 7-BAND BILAN JUFT:
  6  'I HAVE SEEN a play.'     (xabar)
  7  'It WAS entertaining!'    (baho)
tasks.speak: 6  I ......................... (see) a play at the Abbey Theatre.

tasks.prompt: 7  It ......................... (be) very entertaining!
tasks.whyUz:
O'sha spektakl haqida BAHO → PAST SIMPLE.

Baho DOIM Past Simple da beriladi:
Jekning xati: 'They WERE amazing.'
'The place WAS fantastic.'

'entertaining' = maroqli, qiziqarli.

tasks.prompt: 8  I ......................... (also/visit) the Guinness Brewery.
tasks.whyUz:
Vaqt AYTILMAGAN → PRESENT PERFECT.

'ALSO' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA:
'I have ALSO visited ...'

Jekning xati: 'I have ALSO SEEN the
Pyramids.'

KALIT: 'ON SATURDAY' — ANIQ VAQT
→ PAST SIMPLE.

⚠ 8-BAND BILAN JUFT:
  8  'I HAVE ALSO VISITED ...'  (vaqt yo'q)
  9  'I VISITED it ON SATURDAY.' (aniq vaqt)

Jekning xati: 'We VISITED it ON TUESDAY.'

tasks.prompt: 10  They ......................... (show) our tour group how they make beer.
tasks.promptUz: Ular ekskursiya guruhimizga pivoni qanday tayyorlashni ko'rsatishdi.
tasks.whyUz:
O'sha tashrif haqida (shanba kuni)
→ PAST SIMPLE.

show → SHOWED (to'g'ri fe'l).

'a tour group' = ekskursiya guruhi.
'how they make beer' — ergash gap
(so'z tartibi TO'G'RI, savol tartibi emas).
tasks.speak: 10  They ......................... (show) our tour group how they make beer.

tasks.prompt: 11  There are a lot of things I ......................... (not/do) yet.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT INKOR.

do → DONE.

Jekning xati: 'There are a lot of things I
HAVEN'T DONE YET.' — AYNAN bir xil gap!
tasks.speak: 11  There are a lot of things I ......................... (not/do) yet.

tasks.prompt: 12  I ......................... (not/do) any shopping on Grafton Street yet
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT INKOR.

'do the shopping' = xarid qilmoq.

DIQQAT: INKOR gapda 'some' emas, 'ANY':
'haven't done ANY shopping'.
tasks.speak: 12  I ......................... (not/do) any shopping on Grafton Street yet

tasks.prompt: 13  and I ......................... (not/be) to any pubs yet.
tasks.promptUz: va hali hech qanday pabga bormadim.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT INKOR.

⚠ 'BEEN', 'GONE' EMAS:
Grammar 65-bet qoidasi — 'have been to' =
tajriba (borib qaytish).

'ANY pubs' — inkor gapda 'any'.
tasks.speak: 13  and I ......................... (not/be) to any pubs yet.

tasks.prompt: 14  Dublin ......................... (be) a very friendly city
tasks.whyUz:
Doimiy holat / fikr → PRESENT SIMPLE.

Jekning xati: 'Cairo IS a fascinating city.'

KALIT: 'ON THE 16TH' — ANIQ SANA bilan REJA
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

Unit 13 dan: aniq vaqtli reja → Present
Continuous.

Jekning xati: 'I'M RETURNING to England ON
SUNDAY next week.'

VA'DA → WILL.

Jekning xati: 'so I'LL CALL you then.' —
AYNAN bir xil gap!

Unit 13 dan: WILL — va'da.

Present Perfect uchun III shakl (V3) kerak.

items.derived: Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.

wordFormation.ruleUz: ⚠ PRESENT PERFECT va PAST SIMPLE — VAQT RAVISHLARI
EVER / NEVER / YET / ALREADY — QAYERDA TURADI

wordFormation.explanationUz: Savol bering: QANCHA VAQT? yoki QACHONDAN BERI?

wordFormation.explanationUz: O'timli fe'ldan keyin TO'LDIRUVCHI kelishi SHART.

items.derivedUz: I HAVE JUST TURNED it on.

I AM COMING back on the 16th.
